items.summary: @fastify/express is the plugin that lets an application run Express middleware and Express applications inside the Fastify web framework. In versions from 4.0.5 before 4.0.14, a mount path that begins with an Express 5 optional leading segment written as a group is treated as relative and has a slash prepended when it is joined to the plugin prefix, which changes what the pattern matches so the middleware ends up mounted on a path that no longer corresponds to the real request paths. The middleware therefore never runs for requests that match the intended routes, while the Fastify routes still…

items.title: CVE-2026-76075
items.summary: The Warehouse Cargo theme for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in versions up to, and including, 2.7.4 via the warehouse_cargo_install_and_activate_plugin() AJAX handler. The handler is registered on wp_ajax_ but performs no nonce verification and no capability check, allowing any authenticated user to supply an attacker-controlled URL that the server fetches, writes into wp-content/plugins/ with file_put_contents(), extracts with unzip_file() (which does not filter file extensions), and then activates via activate_plugin(). This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, w…

items.title: CVE-2026-135205
items.summary: @fastify/middie is the plugin that adds Express-style middleware support to the Fastify web framework. In versions 9.3.6 through 9.3.9, a route or mount path written without a leading slash inside a plugin registered under a prefix is handled inconsistently: the middleware is mounted with a separating slash after the prefix, while the route is concatenated directly onto the prefix, so a request to the concatenated path reaches the route handler without running the middleware mounted for it. An attacker can use this to bypass authentication or other middleware-based access controls on the affec…

items.title: CVE-2026-137409
items.summary: A flaw has been found in chuckfairy node-webcam up to 0.8.2. This vulnerability affects the function generateSh of the file src/webcams/FSWebcam.js of the component FSWebcam. Executing a manipulation can lead to os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been published and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-137407
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Max Foundry Media Library Folders Plugin up to 8.4.3 on WordPress. Affected by this issue is the function mlfp_toggle_file_access of the file media-library-plus.php of the component Block Direct Access. Such manipulation of the argument file_id leads to missing authorization. The attack can be executed remotely. Upgrading to version 8.4.4 can resolve this issue. You should upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-92251
items.summary: The ZarinPal Payment Gateway for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in versions up to, and including, 5.1.1 via the `Return_from_ZarinPal_Gateway()` handler registered on the `woocommerce_api_wc_zpal` (`?wc-api=wc_zpal`) endpoint. The handler accepts a `wc_order` parameter from the query string, loads the corresponding WooCommerce order without any authentication, nonce, session, capability, or ownership check, and — when the order is paid — issues a 302 redirect to `get_return_url($order)`, whose `Location` header embeds the order's secret `orde…

items.title: CVE-2026-137563
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework from 4.2.1 before 4.2.6 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that exposes decryption keys in exception stack traces when JWE tokens are rejected. Attackers can submit crafted JWE tokens so JWELoader and JWEDecrypter record dir, AES key wrapping, PBES2-derived or content encryption keys in logged trace arguments readable by others.

items.title: CVE-2026-137557
items.summary: SunEditor from 3.0.0 before 3.4.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the codeBlock plugin that allows attackers to inject script via entity-encoded pre language class values. Attackers can store content whose language- class decodes to HTML written via innerHTML into the hover button, executing script when victims hover over the block.

items.title: CVE-2026-137550
items.summary: Frappe Framework before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Document.update() that fails to validate whether the caller is permitted to submit or modify the target document. Attackers can invoke document update operations to submit or alter documents they are not authorized to change.

items.title: CVE-2026-137546
items.summary: Coder 2.29.17 before 2.29.27, 2.32.7 before 2.33.0, 2.33.8 before 2.34.0, 2.34.2 before 2.34.19, 2.35.0 before 2.37.11, 2.38.0 before 2.38.7, and 2.39.0 before 2.39.1 contains a credential exposure vulnerability that allows malicious template authors to steal session tokens because coder open app substitutes $SESSION_TOKEN into template-defined external app URLs without validating scheme or destination. Attackers can define an external app URL or IDE link pointing to an attacker server so users running coder open app leak their token, enabling impersonation of shared users or administrators.

items.title: CVE-2026-137543
items.summary: LaraDashboard before 1.5.2 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to reach internal services by abusing the unvalidated ai_ollama_base_url setting. Once a settings.edit user points the Ollama base URL internally, any post.create user can call /admin/ai/generate-seo with provider=ollama to fetch internal data reflected in SEO fields.

items.title: CVE-2026-137538
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an insufficient session expiration vulnerability that allows attackers to reuse expired JWTs because the passport-jwt strategy sets ignoreExpiration to true. Attackers holding a leaked tj_auth_token can keep sessions alive through auto-extended expiry and two-year cookies to persistently access victim accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-137534
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privilege app/query viewers to obtain plaintext workspace secrets by running REST queries. Attackers can execute queries via POST /data-queries/:id/run whose URL params or non-redacted headers reference secrets, reading resolved values from metadata.request despite lacking decrypted constants access.

items.title: CVE-2026-137530
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.94-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in getVersionsByEnvironment that allows authenticated users to read another organization's application versions due to missing organizationId scoping. Attackers can request the app-environments versions route with their own priority-1 production environment id and a victim app_id to retrieve the victim's version list and structure.

items.title: CVE-2026-137525
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows users with TEST_CONNECTION ability to exfiltrate organization secrets by resolving secret placeholders in test-connection options. Attackers can point the host and port at a listener they control and set the password option to a secrets template, causing the server to send the plaintext secret to them.

items.title: CVE-2026-137520
items.summary: ToolJet before 3.21.96-LTS is missing the ValidateDataSourceGuard on the dependent-queries route of the data-sources controller and does not scope the datasource lookup to the caller's organization. An authenticated admin or builder with dataSourceDelete can request /api/data-sources/dependent-queries/ to confirm a datasource exists in another organization and learn its dependent-query count.

items.title: CVE-2026-137516
items.summary: AzuraCast before 0.24.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the StationPublicApi middleware that allows any authenticated user to access non-public stations without per-station permissions. Attackers can change the station_id path parameter to list and download on-demand media, read schedule data, and submit song requests to unauthorized stations.

items.title: CVE-2026-137515
items.summary: AzuraCast before 0.24.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in RelaysController::updateAction that allows any authenticated user to modify shared relays and delete other stations' relay associations. Attackers can POST a relay base_url to /internal/relays to rename the relay, wipe StationRemote rows of unmanaged stations, and spoof public now-playing data.

items.title: CVE-2026-137511
items.summary: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a state isolation vulnerability because TemplateContext.Reset() does not clear the Tags dictionary holding array.cycle and math.random state. Attackers supplying templates to a reused context can observe or influence cycle positions and random sequences across renders, and accumulate unbounded cycle entries to exhaust memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-137510
items.summary: Scriban and Scriban.Signed before 7.6.0 allow template authors to bypass the LimitToString string length limit because the string.literal, string.base64_encode, html.escape, html.newline_to_br, html.url_encode, and html.url_escape builtins lack allocation guards. An attacker who can supply a small template can repeatedly call these builtins under the default TemplateContext to force multi-gigabyte allocations and exhaust host memory.

items.title: CVE-2026-137508
items.summary: Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in object.to_json that allows template authors to bypass the LimitToString string length limit by serializing into an unbounded MemoryStream. Attackers can repeatedly apply object.to_json to escape-heavy strings in a tiny template, amplifying output to multi-gigabyte heap allocations and causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137505
items.summary: actix-http before 3.20.4 contains a response desynchronization vulnerability in its HTTP/1 client response decoder, which reads bodies on 1xx, 204 and 304 responses based on Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding headers. Servers sending such responses with framing headers cause awc clients to consume subsequent keep-alive responses, causing request failures or misattributing responses across users in proxies.

items.title: CVE-2026-137503
items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a JSON injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject JSON structure into S3 delete and Google Sheets row fields via unescaped template parameters. Attackers can submit crafted parameters to the queries endpoint to add extra Key entries, deleting chosen S3 objects or overriding Sheets row columns.

items.title: CVE-2026-137405
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. Affected is the function move_uploaded_file of the file /admin/add_food.php of the component File Upload Handler. The manipulation of the argument image/new_image/update_image results in unrestricted upload. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-109586
items.summary: The WP STAGING – Backups & Restore, Migration & Clone Plugin – Cloud Backups, Scheduled Backups plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 4.17.0 via the `REQUEST_URI` query parameter. This is due to a parser-differential flaw in `showLoginForm()`: the plugin's `isRestUrl()` function performs an unanchored `strpos()` prefix match against the full `REQUEST_URI` — including the query string — and short-circuits all authorization checks (including `isStagingSite()` and `current_user_can('manage_options')`) whenever it detects a REST-like URL,…

items.title: CVE-2026-137494
items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a broken object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table write access to reference other tenants' files by supplying arbitrary attachment keys on row save. Attackers can inject a victim app's attachment key into a row, then update or delete the row to delete that object from the shared APPS bucket or read it via presigned URLs.

items.title: CVE-2026-137492
items.summary: Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows workspace-scoped builders to access other workspaces' backups by supplying a foreign backupId. Attackers can substitute predictable backup IDs in backup download, import, update, or delete routes to steal archives, restore victim data into their workspace, or delete backups.

items.title: CVE-2026-137490
items.summary: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows restricted subjects to execute arbitrary queries by calling the JavaScript surrealdb.query() bridge. Attackers permitted to run a specific script can bypass the Capabilities::allows_query() gate in the query module to execute unrestricted queries beyond their predefined operations.

items.title: CVE-2026-137489
items.summary: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the remote HTTP client router that passes raw model names to Url::join during ML export. Attackers can supply an absolute URL as the model name in ExportMl or ExportBytesMl commands to redirect authenticated requests and capture session tokens.

items.title: CVE-2026-137488
items.summary: SurrealDB before 4.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read SELECT-hidden edge endpoints through InOverride/OutOverride error messages. Attackers with CREATE and UPDATE permission on an edge table can re-RELATE an existing edge with mismatched endpoints to recover stored in/out record ids despite row- or field-level restrictions.

items.title: CVE-2026-137487
items.summary: OpenWrt LuCI luci-app-unbound through 26.288.56989~75a306d contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the Unbound Configure page inserts the dhcp.odhcpd.leasetrigger value into a warning notification without escaping. Users with delegated network configuration access can store an HTML event handler in that option through the permitted uci RPC, which executes in an administrator's browser session when the page renders.

items.title: CVE-2026-137475
items.summary: vLLM 0.21.0 before 0.28.0, when using the V1 model runner, contains a state aliasing flaw in ThinkingBudgetStateHolder.sync_batch(), whose SWAP branch copies thinking-budget state to the destination batch row without removing the source entry. Attackers submitting requests with thinking_token_budget can force the reasoning-end token sequence into a concurrent co-batched request's output during a mixed batch reorder.

items.title: CVE-2026-137474
items.summary: SiYuan 3.8.8 before 3.8.10 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that creates workspace directories with mode 0755 and conf.json with mode 0644, exposing the cleartext AccessAuthCode administrator credential. Local users able to traverse the SiYuan user's home path can read it and authenticate as administrator via Basic authentication, for example calling /api/system/setAPIToken to change the API token.

items.title: CVE-2026-137473
items.summary: SiYuan from 3.8.6-beta.1 before 3.8.10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows read-only publish users (RoleReader) to modify persistent workspace configuration via /api/system/getChangelog. Attackers can send POST requests through the publish service proxy, even anonymously when basic authentication is disabled, to persist ShowChangelog = false to conf.json.

items.title: CVE-2026-137472
items.summary: SiYuan from 3.6.2 before 3.8.10 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows admin token holders to read files outside the workspace because the globalCopyFiles and workspaceCopyFiles denylist omits /home, /mnt, /media, and /snap. Attackers can copy other users' SSH authorized_keys, Docker and AWS configs, or mounted files into the workspace and retrieve them via the getFile API.

items.title: CVE-2026-137471
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability where WebDAV sync error formatting skips HTML escaping for certain malformed-response errors, passing raw markup to the Electron notification renderer. A network attacker who alters a cleartext HTTP WebDAV response can inject event-handler markup that, when the victim manually starts sync, executes JavaScript with Node integration as the logged-in user.

items.title: CVE-2026-137470
items.summary: SiYuan before 3.8.11 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject DOM event handlers by storing handler-named block attributes such as onmouseover. Attackers can share crafted .sy.zip packages or Markdown files whose attributes reach renderCustom or the unsanitised preview pane, executing OS commands via Node integration in the desktop app.

items.title: CVE-2026-137469
items.summary: SiYuan 3.7.0 before 3.8.11 contains a DOM-based cross-site scripting vulnerability in the AI agent chat panel, which renders final and saved assistant replies into innerHTML without HTML sanitisation. Attackers influencing model replies via indirect prompt injection or a configured model endpoint can inject event-handler markup, executing OS commands through Node.js integration in desktop local-kernel mode.

items.title: CVE-2026-137464
items.summary: ImageMagick 7.0.0 before 7.1.2-35 and before 6.9.13-60 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the distributed pixel cache server, which transmits pixel and metadata content in cleartext. Attackers who can observe traffic between a DPC client and server can read transmitted image data.

items.title: CVE-2026-137461
items.summary: FreeRDP from 3.0.0 before 3.33.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in cert_write_server_certificate_v1() that computes the proprietary certificate signature over a freed stream buffer after reallocation. Clients negotiating Standard RDP Security with many static channels against servers using 3072- or 4096-bit keys trigger freed heap reads, producing invalid certificate signatures.

items.title: CVE-2026-137460
items.summary: FreeRDP from 3.10.0 before 3.33.0 contains an invalid free vulnerability in rdg.c because the websocket context pointer shares a union with chunked transfer-encoding decoder state. A malicious RD Gateway answering the data channel with chunked encoding can control the overwritten pointer via chunk sizes, causing rdg_free to free an attacker-influenced value and crash the client.

items.title: CVE-2026-137459
items.summary: FreeRDP 2.11.2 before 3.33.0 contains unbounded resource consumption in the Progressive codec because progressive_decompress() resets the tile update batch only when frameId changes. A malicious RDP server can repeat RDPGFX_CAPROGRESSIVE WireToSurface2 commands with a constant frameId to cause unbounded memory growth, quadratic CPU cost, a heap out-of-bounds write on tile-cache allocation failure, and client crashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-137453
items.summary: FreeRDP before 3.33.0 contains a credential disclosure vulnerability that allows malicious RDP servers to obtain client passwords because rdp_write_info_packet() omits a Remote Credential Guard check. When a victim connects using /remoteGuard with a configured /p password, the client sends the password in the Client Info packet after CredSSP, exposing reusable credentials to the destination.

items.title: CVE-2026-137403
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file /admin/update_food.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument price can lead to sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

items.title: CVE-2026-137404
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Online Food Ordering System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file food-search.php of the component Food Search. The manipulation of the argument Search leads to cross site scripting. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-71409
items.summary: GNU screen is vulnerable to a global buffer overflow in the SendCmdMessage() function within attacher.c. Due to the use of an unchecked sprintf() call when appending the STY environment variable to the global SocketPath buffer. The vulnerability occurs when GNU screen is executed in an environment where the HOME and STY environment variables contain attacker-controlled values that are sufficiently long. Successful exploitation may result in an application crash or potentially arbitrary code execution. This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-137578
items.summary: FacturaONE para WooCommerce con VeriFactu before 5.61 contains an authenticated SQL injection vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to inject SQL through the fone_client_id user meta value. Attackers can store a payload in their own profile via FONE_update_tarifa_user(), which FONE_product_ids_ocultos_para_usuario() concatenates unquoted, enabling time-based blind extraction of password hashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-137576
items.summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust disk space by uploading files to the POST /data/import route. Attackers without import permission can repeatedly upload input_file payloads that are stored in storage/app/temp and parsed before permission checks, never deleted, causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137573
items.summary: KodeRover Zadig before 5.1.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in aslan environment kube.go handlers that allows authenticated users to query Kubernetes clusters of other projects. Attackers can supply arbitrary clusterID and namespace values to /api/aslan/environment/kube/ routes to enumerate namespaces, nodes, deployments, workloads, canary mappings, and resource names.

items.title: CVE-2026-137566
items.summary: Argo Workflows 3.0.0 through 3.7.18, 4.0.0 before 4.0.12, and 4.1.0 before 4.1.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the S3, GCS, and Azure Blob artifact drivers. Attackers who can write bucket objects or supply malicious artifact sources can use object keys containing ../ sequences to write arbitrary files in the executor pod, achieving code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-62272
items.summary: Relative Path Traversal vulnerability in ex-aws ex_aws_lambda (ExAws.Lambda module) allows an attacker to redirect an AWS Lambda control-plane request at an unintended resource by injecting path traversal sequences into a caller-supplied identifier. This vulnerability is associated with program file lib/ex_aws/lambda.ex and program routines ExAws.Lambda.add_permission/5, ExAws.Lambda.delete_event_source_mapping/1, ExAws.Lambda.delete_function/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_event_source_mapping/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_function/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_function_configuration/1, ExAws.Lambda.get_policy/1, ExAws.Lamb…

items.title: CVE-2026-124756
items.summary: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling vulnerability in Takashi Kitajima MW WP Form mw-wp-form allows HTTP DoS.This issue affects MW WP Form: from n/a through 5.1.8.

items.title: CVE-2026-111846
items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WPExperts NOWPayments for WooCommerce nowpayments-for-woocommerce allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects NOWPayments for WooCommerce: from n/a through 1.4.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-132206
items.summary: The Taskbuilder – Project Management & Task Management Tool With Kanban Board plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'display_name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.0.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload fires specifically when an authenticated user with access to the Tasks admin panel applies the 'Created By' filte…

items.title: CVE-2026-130331
items.summary: The WP Statistics – Simple, privacy-friendly Google Analytics alternative plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in all versions up to, and including, 14.16.19 via the 'tab' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to include and execute arbitrary .php files on the server, allowing the execution of any PHP code in those files. This can be used to bypass access controls, obtain sensitive data, or achieve code execution in cases where .php file types can be uploaded and included. The exploitability of thi…

items.title: CVE-2026-107769
items.summary: The Fluent Forms – Customizable Contact Forms, Survey, Quiz, & Conversational Form Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Account Pre-Hijacking via Unverified Identifier in all versions up to, and including, 6.2.15. The vulnerability exists because the `PaymentHandler::maybeAssignTransactions()` function, registered on the `user_register` hook at priority 99, resolves the lookup email solely from the newly created user record via the `user_email` parameter with no prior verification that the registrant actually controls that address, then bulk-updates all guest transactions and submissi…

items.title: CVE-2026-120353
items.summary: The Apache Airflow TaskFlow decorators @task.bash, @task.sql, @task.analytics, @task.kubernetes_cmd and the common.ai decorators (@task.llm, @task.agent, @task.llm_sql, @task.llm_branch, @task.llm_file_analysis, @task.llm_schema_compare) rendered Jinja templates a second time after the task runner had already rendered them, so any value copied into env, op_args, op_kwargs or the returned prompt, command or SQL was evaluated as a template on the worker. An attacker who can only trigger a Dag run (for example a user with trigger permission supplying run conf), or who controls text that a Dag pas…

items.title: CVE-2026-135645
items.summary: The Everest Forms – Contact Form, Payment Form, Quiz, Survey & Custom Form Builder with AI plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to File Deletion in all versions up to, and including, 3.6.4 This is due to the `delete_entry_files()` function gating file cleanup on a loose `preg_match('/signature_/', $meta_key)` substring check against the entry's meta-key rather than verifying the actual field type, which allows an ordinary Text field whose label begins with "Signature" to generate a qualifying meta-key such as `signature_1` — causing the attacker-controlled value submitted via `everest_forms[form…

items.title: CVE-2026-135027
items.summary: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Kitae Park Mang Board WP mangboard allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Mang Board WP: from n/a through 2.4.9.

items.title: CVE-2026-137415
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in Tencent RapidJSON up to 1.1.0. This affects the function Writer::WriteString in the library include/rapidjson/writer.h. Performing a manipulation of the argument length results in integer overflow. The attack may be initiated remotely. The patch is named 297637bc0a0f00dc504dbc1a47ebdaa577f8ae19. To fix this issue, it is recommended to deploy a patch.

items.title: CVE-2026-110699
items.summary: Chainlit is vulnerable to a file upload block bypass in the "spontaneous_file_upload" functionality. Disabling the feature with the "enabled = false" option only affects the frontend, while the backend upload endpoints remain active and can be abused directly. An attacker with a valid session ID can send requests to these backend endpoints to upload arbitrary file types and then generate a retrieval URL that is accessible to anyone who obtains the link. This allows the attacker to serve malicious content, such as a fake login pages, from the application's trusted domain, which can be used for…

items.title: CVE-2026-137587
items.summary: LIVE555 Streaming Media before 2026.08.25 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in parseVorbisOrTheoraConfigStr() that trusts attacker-supplied 16-bit header length fields. A malicious RTSP server or crafted SDP Vorbis or Theora configuration can crash clients or leak heap memory through proxied SDP configurations.

items.title: CVE-2026-137577
items.summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to modify any user record by supplying arbitrary record_id values to POST /data/save. Attackers can submit a save request for the ice_users module with the administrator's record_id to change their password or email and take over the account.

items.title: CVE-2026-137575
items.summary: Listmonk 4.1.0 through 7.0.0-beta.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in CSV subscriber import that allows list-scoped users to overwrite subscribers outside their permitted lists. Attackers holding subscribers:import and list:manage on one list can import CSV rows with victims' emails and overwrite enabled to modify names, attributes, and list memberships.

items.title: CVE-2026-137574
items.summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the related_fields and related_field_name routes in routes/data.php that lets authenticated users read restricted module data. Attackers can enumerate field_id values to query related module tables without Permission::checkPermission checks, reading id and name pairs such as user names from ice_users.

items.title: CVE-2026-137572
items.summary: Iceburg CRM through 5.0.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to modify workflows by calling the workflow save and delete endpoints. Attackers can send an empty workflow array to /data/workflow/save or call DELETE /data/workflow/{id} to wipe or rewrite the module conversion workflow.

items.title: CVE-2026-137570
items.summary: Open Policy Agent before 1.20.0 contains an insecure temporary file vulnerability that allows local users to overwrite files by abusing the fixed OCI store path used when persistence_directory is unset. Attackers can pre-create the opa/oci temp directory with index.json or oci-layout symlinks so OPA overwrites the target files with OCI JSON using its privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137569
items.summary: Golift xtractr before 0.4.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction root because a strings.HasPrefix output directory check lacks separator awareness. Attackers can supply ZIP, TAR, 7z, RAR, or other archives with entries like ../_evil/file to create or overwrite files in sibling directories.

items.title: CVE-2026-137568
items.summary: openFrameworks through 0.12.1 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the ofxAndroid OFZipUtil.extract helper that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction directory. Attackers can supply a crafted ZIP archive with entries like ../escaped.txt to write or overwrite files with the Android application's file permissions.

items.title: CVE-2026-71410
items.summary: GNU Screen is vulnerable to a Use-After-Free in the utf8_handle_comb() function in encoding.c. Due to improper error handling during memory allocation failure, the global combchars pointer is freed but not reset to NULL. When a subsequent combining Unicode character arrives at the terminal, the function dereferences the freed pointer. An attacker who controls terminal content sent to the screen session, such as via a rogue SSH server or crafted escape sequences, can exploit this vulnerability to perform heap grooming and achieve arbitrary code execution. This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2.

items.title: CVE-2026-122065

items.title: CVE-2026-137579
items.summary: Web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6, and jwt-core through 3.2.10, perform unblinded RSA private key operations in RSAKey::exponentiate(), so CRT recombination time reveals whether a decrypted RSA-OAEP, RSA-OAEP-256, or RSA1_5 value is below the prime q. Attackers who can submit JWEs can time rejections of crafted tokens to binary search q, factor the modulus, and decrypt all JWEs encrypted to that key.

items.title: CVE-2026-137564
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.x before 4.0.9, 4.1.x before 4.1.11, and 4.2.x before 4.2.6 (and jwt-encryption through 3.2.10) do not check the key length in JWEBuilder and JWEDecrypter for direct (dir) encryption, so undersized keys are zero-padded. Anyone holding a token issued with a half-size AES-CBC-HMAC key can decrypt it, and an empty key also allows forging tokens the decrypter accepts.

items.title: CVE-2026-137562
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6 does not check oct key length in the AESKW, AESGCMKW, and experimental AESCTR and chacha20-poly1305 key encryption algorithms, so OpenSSL zero-pads short or empty keys. When an application uses an empty key, anyone can unwrap content encryption keys under the all-zero key to read issued tokens and forge accepted ones.

items.title: CVE-2026-137561
items.summary: Web-Token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6, and jwt-encryption through 3.2.10, contain a token malleability flaw because JWEDecrypter does not reject a non-empty JWE Encrypted Key with the dir, ECDH-ES and ECDH-SS algorithms, which the authentication tag does not cover. Attackers holding one token can fill the Encrypted Key with arbitrary bytes to derive unlimited distinct token strings that still decrypt, bypassing replay caches, single-use registries or revocation deny-lists keyed on the token string.

items.title: CVE-2026-137558
items.summary: web-token jwt-framework and jwt-library before 3.4.13, 4.0.0 before 4.0.9, 4.1.0 before 4.1.11, and 4.2.0 before 4.2.6 contain a decryption oracle in RSACrypt::decryptWithRSAOAEP(), which accepts a JWE Encrypted Key made of multiple RSA blocks instead of a single RSAES-OAEP ciphertext. Attackers holding the recipient's public key can embed a captured encrypted key among crafted blocks and, using an accepted AES-CBC-HMAC algorithm and a decryption success signal, recover its CEK byte by byte to decrypt the captured JWE.

items.title: CVE-2026-137477
items.summary: vLLM 0.16.0 before 0.21.0 leaks token data between users when the V1 model runner uses async scheduling with pipeline parallelism, because non-last pipeline ranks never write generated tokens to token_ids_cpu and reset num_tokens_no_spec each step. When the fallback path is triggered, such as by mixed prefill/decode batches, stale tokens from a prior request in the same batch slot become model input and are written to the KV cache, exposing fragments of one user's context in another user's response.

items.title: CVE-2026-137035
items.summary: A flaw was found in bootc. On a sealed composefs boot with a strict composefs digest on the kernel command line, the initramfs derives fs-verity enforcement from unsigned repository metadata and can mount an image under images/refs without measuring it against that digest. An attacker with offline write access to the root filesystem can boot a modified root under a legitimately signed UKI.

items.title: CVE-2026-129838
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. This vulnerability allows a local user to spoof sender identity and cause downstream log consumers to misattribute event origins. When the imuxsock module is configured with plain trusted-property annotation, it fails to properly escape process names and executable paths in log metadata. A local attacker can exploit this issue by sending log messages through the local log socket with crafted process names to inject forged identity attributes.

items.title: CVE-2026-71296
items.summary: A flaw was found in maestro. A remote attacker could exploit a misconfiguration in the gRPC server where authentication defaults to a 'mock' mode. This default setting bypasses all authentication and authorization, allowing an unauthorized attacker to write resource bundles. Consequently, this could lead to arbitrary code execution on managed clusters.

items.title: CVE-2026-137079
items.summary: libvorbis through 1.3.7 contains a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in _ov_getlap() in lib/vorbisfile.c that passes a negative sample count from vorbis_synthesis_lapout() to memcpy(). Attackers can supply a short, valid Ogg Vorbis file with suitable block sizes to overwrite stack frames and crash applications performing two consecutive lapped seeks.

items.title: CVE-2026-137063
items.summary: Leptonica 1.79.0 through 1.87.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in l_byteaInitFromStream() that allows attackers to write past a heap buffer by supplying oversized input. Attackers can provide a file larger than 1,000,000,000 bytes, causing l_byteaCreate() to allocate a 201-byte buffer before memcpy copies the full stream size, crashing the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-136831
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in WPExperts New User Approve Plugin up to 3.3 on WordPress. Impacted is the function update_user_role of the file includes/end-points/class-users-api.php of the component REST API. Executing a manipulation can lead to missing authorization. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

items.title: CVE-2026-137089
items.summary: merge-deep-composed through 0.1.4 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in _mergeDeepOne() that allows remote attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying __proto__ keys. Attackers can pass JSON-parsed input containing __proto__ as a merge source to inject inherited properties, causing logic bypass or denial of service in Node.js processes.

items.title: CVE-2026-137062
items.summary: BookStack before 26.09.3 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated Editors to permanently delete recycle bin content by converting chapters to books or books to shelves. Attackers can trigger TrashCan::destroyEntity() through the conversion actions to force-delete soft-deleted children, revisions and attachments, including content deleted by other users, preventing restoration.

items.title: CVE-2026-137061
items.summary: Wallos before 5.11.2 contains an infinite loop vulnerability that allows authenticated users or API key holders to exhaust server resources by storing subscriptions with a frequency of 0. Attackers can trigger renew.php or get_monthly_cost.php to loop forever on a P0D interval, pinning PHP workers and hanging the next-payment cron job for all users.

items.summary: A vulnerability was found in D-Link R32 1.10B02. This affects an unknown function of the file /usr/bin/httpd of the component flupl self Endpoint. items.summary: In gdm3 before 51.2, an improper privilege management vulnerability allows an unprivileged local attacker with an active GDM graphical session to execute arbitrary code as root by supplying a malicious environment variable during session reauthentication.

items.title: CVE-2026-17194
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 16.7.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with developer-role permissions to merge code changes into protected branches without triggering approval resets due to the use of a weak hash function in the merge request approval change detection mechanism.

items.title: CVE-2026-135487
items.summary: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-15 contained a stored HTML injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to store markup in the profile full_name field by submitting a modified request directly to the backend, which persists the value without sanitization. The Contact Support workflow later inserts the stored name into the generated support email without HTML encoding, so attackers can make injected HTML and media, such as misleading banners, masked hyperlinks and external tracking resources, render in support messages received by the support team.

items.title: CVE-2026-137093
items.summary: Assimp before 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in MD5Importer::LoadMD5MeshFile() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory via unvalidated weight ranges and bone indices. Attackers can supply a crafted .md5mesh file with out-of-range mBone values to increment heap words past the piCount allocation, causing memory corruption, out-of-bounds reads, or crashes.

items.title: CVE-2026-137092
items.summary: Assimp before 6.0.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in MD5Importer::MakeDataUnique() that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory by supplying unvalidated face indices. Attackers can craft an .md5mesh file with out-of-range face vertex indices or unfilled faces to set bits past the abHad allocation, read vertex data out of bounds, or crash the application.

items.title: CVE-2026-137091
items.summary: EverOS before 1.8.0 contains a cross-origin local file disclosure vulnerability that allows malicious websites to read local files by abusing a wildcard CORS policy with credentials and unrestricted file:// ingestion. Attackers can host JavaScript that calls POST /api/v2/memory/add with file:// URIs, then read parsed contents via POST /api/v2/memory/search to exfiltrate SSH keys, credentials, and alter or delete memories.

items.title: CVE-2026-137090
items.summary: build-git-clone before 1.0.4 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the clone() function that allows attackers to execute commands by supplying crafted repository URLs. Attackers can embed shell metacharacters such as ; or $() in the url argument, which is concatenated into a sh -c command, to execute operating system commands with Node.js process privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137088
items.summary: @oleksii-pavlov/deep-merge before 1.2.4 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in deepMergeTwoAssignable() that allows remote attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying a __proto__ key. Attackers can pass JSON-parsed input to deepMerge(), deepMergeAndAssign(), deepUpdate() or deepUpdateAndAssign() to inject inherited properties, causing logic bypass or denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137087
items.summary: @irrelon/path 6.2.2 before 7.0.3 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in merge() and mergeImmutable() that allows remote attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying __proto__ keys. Attackers can pass untrusted JSON containing __proto__ or constructor.prototype payloads to merged objects, causing property injection, authorization bypass, or denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137085
items.summary: ProjeQtOr before 13.1.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in tool/getAFieldForAClassById.php that allows authenticated low-privilege users to read any object property. Attackers can request Class=User with an administrator id and field=password or email to retrieve password hashes for offline cracking.

items.title: CVE-2026-137083
items.summary: OpenCV 3.0.0 through 4.14.0 and 5.0.0 through 5.1.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the built-in MJPEG encoder when writing grayscale frames due to incorrect level shifting in convertToYUV(). Attackers controlling pixel content written as grayscale MJPEG video can trigger unchecked cat_table and huff_dc_tab lookups, leaking adjacent or uninitialized memory into the output file or crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-137082
items.summary: GNOME libxml2 through 2.15.4 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmlParseStartTag2() that allows attackers to crash applications by triggering parser context reuse after SAX1 parsing. Attackers can supply documents with attributes parsed first with XML_PARSE_SAX1 and then without it on a reused context, causing writes to unallocated ctxt->attallocs and denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137080
items.summary: libical 4.0.0 before 4.0.7 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in icalrecur_iterator_set_range() that allows attackers to cause denial of service by supplying crafted recurrence rules. Attackers can provide a calendar whose recurrence rule is iterated over a reverse range, causing the loop to never terminate and spin the calling thread at full CPU indefinitely.

items.title: CVE-2026-137078
items.summary: Xiph.Org libvorbis through 1.3.7 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in ov_time_tell() in lib/vorbisfile.c that reads vf->vi[-1].rate after a failed seek leaves vf->pcm_offset at -1. Attackers can supply a crafted Ogg Vorbis file with a corrupted page to applications that seek and query playback time, leaking heap bytes via the returned value or crashing the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-137076
items.summary: FFmpeg through 9.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability because avcodec_flush_buffers() does not release the decoder context's frame buffer pool, so recycled buffers retain prior picture data. Attackers can supply crafted damaged streams to applications reusing one decoder context across users to recover another user's decoded picture content from unwritten frame regions.

items.title: CVE-2026-137074
items.summary: GNOME libxml2 2.12.6 through 2.15.4 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in xmlTextReaderConstEncoding() after a reader is reset with xmlReaderNewWalker(). Because xmlCtxtReset() leaves ctxt->input NULL, querying the document encoding makes xmlGetActualEncoding() read ctxt->input->flags without a check, crashing the application and causing denial of service.

items.title: CVE-2026-137073
items.summary: GNOME libxml2 through 2.15.4 contains a double free vulnerability in xmlReaderNewWalker() that frees reader->input again after xmlTextReaderClose() already released it. Applications reusing a closed xmlTextReader with xmlReaderNewWalker() can crash, and groomed heap memory can control the close callback for possible code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-137072
items.summary: GNOME libxml2 2.9.10 through 2.15.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows attackers to trigger stale DTD validation states after xmlTextReaderCurrentDoc documents are freed. Attackers can supply an XML document ending with an error inside an element, causing xmlTextReaderClose to read freed element declarations, leading to crashes and possible invalid frees.

items.title: CVE-2026-137071
items.summary: Boost.JSON 1.84.0 through 1.92.0 contains an information exposure vulnerability because parser_for reset() does not reset nested parse_into handlers, retaining state across documents. Attackers controlling an abandoned or subsequent document parsed by a reused parser_for can cause partial string data from one document to appear in another's result.

items.title: CVE-2026-137070
items.summary: GEOS 3.13.0 before 3.15.1 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in RectangleContains::isContainedInBoundary that recurses indefinitely on curved geometries returned by getGeometryN. Attackers can supply crafted WKT or WKB CircularString, CompoundCurve, or CurvePolygon geometries tested via PreparedGeometry::contains or GEOSPreparedContains against a prepared rectangle to crash the process with a stack overflow.

items.title: CVE-2026-137069
items.summary: libxml2 2.13.0 through 2.15.4 contains a denial of service vulnerability because xmlTextReaderSetup does not reset reader->state when a reader is reused. Attackers can submit one malformed XML document to an application reusing a single reader, causing every later document to be rejected until the reader is recreated.

items.title: CVE-2026-137068
items.summary: libxml2 through 2.15.4 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability that allows attackers to crash applications by triggering xmlFreeNode on a stale reader->faketext node after xmlTextReader reuse. Attackers can supply XML containing a namespace declaration to applications that read its value and reuse the reader, causing a freed document's dictionary read and process crash.

items.title: CVE-2026-137067
items.summary: GNOME libxml2 2.9.10 through 2.15.4 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmlValidatePopElement because xmlCtxtReset frees the DTD without popping stale validation states. Attackers supplying an XML document ending inside an element to an application reusing a DTD-validating xmlTextReader can trigger heap reads, causing crashes and limited heap disclosure via error messages.

items.title: CVE-2026-137065
items.summary: Chatwoot before 4.20.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows account administrators to attach integration hooks to other accounts' inboxes by supplying a foreign inbox_id. Attackers can create a Dialogflow hook referencing a victim inbox, leaving its new conversations stuck as pending awaiting a bot, and enumerate inbox IDs to disclose inbox names.

items.title: CVE-2026-137060
items.summary: paramz through 0.10.0 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted model files to paramz.load(), which calls pickle.load() without restrictions. Attackers can embed objects whose __reduce__ method returns callables like exec or os.system in shared paramz or GPy model files to run code with the victim's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-137056
items.summary: DeepSeek-Reasonix before 2.53.0 contains a command execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run commands without user approval because the shellsafe classifier treats git blame and git whatchanged as read-only. Attackers can plant a diff textconv driver in .gitattributes and .git/config so that git blame, triggered via prompt injection or routine use, executes attacker-chosen commands with the user's privileges, exposing stored provider API keys and session history.

items.title: CVE-2026-136733
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in EduardoPires EquinoxProject up to 1.10. This vulnerability affects the function BuildToken of the file src/Equinox.Services.Api/appsettings.Development.json of the component JWT Bearer Authentication. This manipulation of the argument SecretKey with the input fmFGn5agHZkuG2N0e1zaEJIQtGVoNN5P causes hard-coded credentials. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

items.title: CVE-2026-133467
items.summary: CodeSafe is an open-source Python library for code encryption, decryption, and safe evaluation using Python's AST module. From versions 0.0.1 through 0.0.4, the safe_eval() function can be bypassed with indirect subscript calls such as builtins'exec', because AST validation blocks only direct calls to dangerous built-ins. An attacker who controls an expression passed to safe_eval() can execute arbitrary Python code with the permissions of the host application. This issue is fixed in version 0.0.5.

items.title: CVE-2026-135636
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 18.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user to send requests to internal network resources due to insufficient validation in repository import.

items.title: CVE-2026-133465
items.summary: Glances is an open-source system cross-platform monitoring tool. In versions prior to 4.5.7, the on-alert action command tokenizer in secure.py treats quote characters as argument boundaries without escaping. A monitored stat value, such as a mount point name, that is quoted in an action command template can contain a quote character that breaks out of its quote boundary and injects additional arguments into the process the action invokes. No shell operator is needed for this attack. This issue has been fixed in version 4.5.7.

items.title: CVE-2026-132822
items.summary: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 11.7 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with Maintainer-role permissions to cause denial of service due to missing resource limits in the error tracking integration.

items.title: CVE-2026-81406
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the read_db2_packet function of the db2-das-info.nse script, which trusts an unmasked 32-bit length field supplied by the server. A malicious DB2 Administration Server on a scanned host can declare a packet length of up to roughly 4.29GB, causing the script to buffer that much data and the Nmap process to exhaust memory; the script runs during version detection (-sV).

items.title: CVE-2026-81405
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the Comm.ReceivePacket function of the NSE rpc.lua library, which buffers ONC-RPC record fragments using the server-declared fragment length without an upper bound. A malicious RPC service on a scanned host can declare fragments of up to roughly 2.1GB, and up to 400 fragments per call, causing the Nmap process to exhaust memory; the read path is reached by rpcinfo.nse during version detection (-sV) and is shared by the NFS, rusers and NetWorker scripts.

items.title: CVE-2026-81414
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the sendPacketsTCP function of the NSE dns.lua library, which reads a DNS-over-TCP response without a size limit and builds it by repeated string concatenation. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data in response to the initial SOA lookup made by dns-zone-transfer.nse, before any AXFR request is sent, causing unbounded memory growth and quadratic CPU cost in the Nmap process.

items.title: CVE-2026-81413
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the inline AXFR response reader of the dns-zone-transfer.nse script, which reads the zone transfer response without a size limit. A malicious DNS server on a scanned host can stream unbounded data over TCP port 53 after the AXFR request, causing the memory of the Nmap process to grow at the attacker's send rate until it is exhausted.

items.title: CVE-2026-136725
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.7. Affected by this issue is the function fillModelFromData of the file src/Services/AdminService.php. The manipulation of the argument id/remember_token/enabled leads to dynamically-determined object attributes. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 4.7.8 can resolve this issue. The identifier of the patch is 9b0c98dc3e2710b2ba8d7579da89ec6a4042fcc8. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

items.title: CVE-2026-136724
items.summary: A vulnerability was detected in slowlyo owl-admin up to 4.7.7. The impacted element is the function update of the file src/Services/AdminUserService.php of the component Admin User Management. The manipulation results in missing authorization. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. Upgrading to version 4.7.8 is sufficient to resolve this issue. The patch is identified as 70910338c1e136d5bdd6ed795768e7a81445f422. The affected component should be upgraded.

items.title: CVE-2026-135486
items.summary: Munshi (by Petpooja) before 2026-07-07 contained a broken object level authorization vulnerability in the PUT /api/invoice/{invoice_id}/extracted-data endpoint, which accepts a client-supplied extracted_data object without verifying invoice ownership, enforcing the invoice_edit permission or checking whether the invoice has been soft deleted. Authenticated attackers who know an invoice identifier can overwrite seller and buyer details, invoice identifiers, product entries, totals and custom metadata of invoices, including archived invoices marked is_deleted = 1, undermining the integrity of fi…

items.title: CVE-2026-133463
items.summary: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for files and blobs. Prior to version 4.46, the S3 gateway does not evaluate bucket policies on POST Object uploads, which are multipart/form-data POST requests to the bucket. An authenticated S3 identity that a bucket policy restricts, such as to a key prefix or by source IP, can create or overwrite objects it is denied by sending the upload as a POST instead of a PUT. This issue has been fixed in version 4.46.

items.title: CVE-2026-135092
items.summary: PDF::API2 versions before 2.049 for Perl allow unbounded recursion via circular cross-reference chains in readxrtr. When a PDF is opened, readxrtr reads each cross-reference table and calls itself on the offset in the trailer's /Prev entry. Nothing records which offsets it has already read, so a /Prev entry pointing back to an earlier table, or to its own, makes it recurse without end. An attacker who supplies a crafted PDF can cause a denial of service in any application that opens it.

items.title: CVE-2022-50996
items.summary: WWW::Form::UrlEncoded::XS versions before 0.28 for Perl write past the end of the Perl argument stack when parse_urlencoded returns many pairs. parse_urlencoded returns its result as a list, pushing each decoded key and value onto the argument stack without first extending the stack to fit them. parse_urlencoded_arrayref returns an array reference and is not affected. A remote client that sends a query string or request body with many pairs to an application parsing it with parse_urlencoded can corrupt memory and crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2022-50995
items.summary: WWW::Form::UrlEncoded::XS versions before 0.27 for Perl read one byte before the input buffer when parsing an empty string. parse_urlencoded and parse_urlencoded_arrayref check for a trailing "&" or ";" by reading the last byte of the input, without first checking that the input has any bytes. A remote client that sends an empty query string or request body to an application parsing it with this module can crash the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-99808

The zero is then sent to the peer in our configuration request, and if the channel ends up in ERTM mode it is passed to l2cap_seq_list_init(). Use the default TxWindow instead, as the mode can still be changed to ERTM during configuration.

It is stored in remote_tx_win unchanged and later passed to l2cap_seq_list_init(), where roundup_pow_of_two(0) is undefined. On some architectures this results in a ZERO_SIZE_PTR list and a remote kernel oops. A TxWindow above 63 is out of spec as well. With 6-bit sequence numbers we would then send more unacknowledged frames than the sequence space can tell apart. Reply with L2C…

The next out-of-sequence I-frame makes l2cap_seq_list_clear() write through the NULL srej_list.list. Refuse the channel when a response tries to change the mode of a connected ch…

items.title: CVE-2026-99805

Unlike the read-only VLAN protocol parser, this path has no limit on the number of nested tags it consumes. Each skb_vlan_untag() advances skb->data and resets header offsets. The offsets are stored in 16-bit fields. With enough nested tags, the network or transport offset can wrap. A later protocol handler can then derive a large pull length from the wrapped offsets and access memory outside the sk…

These positions could lie outside the text or describe another statement: - After SQLExecDirect() failed on a statement handle, the FROM and WHERE positions of the failed statement were applied to the next, shorter statement on that handle. - The parser could record a FROM position with no text after it, and the rewrite then copied a negative length. - An {fn …} escape whose arguments contain FOR UPDATE, ; or INTO … FROM made the driver remove a cursor prefix from the wrong buffer.…

items.title: CVE-2026-136514
items.summary: psqlODBC assumed that a table it reads keeps the definition it had when the statement was described or parsed. A database user who owns a table or view another user's application reads can crash that application, with an honest server and default options, in these cases: - Columns dropped or added in another session while the application updates rows through an updatable cursor, or describes the columns with Parse=1. - A view whose ctid is NULL, read through an updatable cursor, which writes past the row cache, and a view with a volatile filter scrolled backward with UseDeclareFetch=1. - Rows…

items.title: CVE-2026-136511
items.summary: psqlODBC mapped an SSLmode value in a connection string that it did not recognise, such as SSLmode=Require, SSLmode=Verify-Full, SSLmode={require} or SSLmode={verify-full}, to disable. SQLDriverConnect() then returned SQL_SUCCESS with no diagnostic, and the connection was not encrypted. An attacker on the network path of such a connection can read and change its traffic. Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

items.title: CVE-2026-136510
items.summary: A parameter-array execution that fails part-way leaves the rows it has already queued on the statement handle, and the next execution on that handle sends them. After a data-at-execution batch is abandoned, by SQLCancel or a rejected SQLPutData, the next SQLExecDirect sends the failed batch's rows and returns SQL_SUCCESS without sending its own statement. So an application that logs the failure on the same handle has its log entry turned into a silent no-op, while rows it was told had failed are stored. An end user who controls one value in an application's array insert can arrange both halves…

By sending replies that do not match, a hostile or compromised server, or anyone on the network path of a connection that does not use sslmode=verify-full (the default is disable) can corrupt memory in the application: - A FETCH reply with more rows than requested overflows the row cache. - Extra results in re…

items.title: CVE-2026-8748
items.summary: Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl compare HMAC signatures and JWE authentication tags in non-constant time. decode_jwt compares HS256, HS384 and HS512 signatures, and the authentication tag of A128CBC-HS256, A192CBC-HS384 and A256CBC-HS512 encrypted tokens, against the computed value with Perl's eq operator. Its run time depends on the number of matching leading bytes. An attacker who can submit many candidate tokens and measure the timing precisely enough may recover the expected signature or tag byte by byte and forge a token that verifies.

items.title: CVE-2026-136870

The impacted element is the function ovpn-client.add_group of the file /rpc of the component Management RPC. Executing a manipulation can lead to null pointer dereference. The attack may be launched remotely. The affected component s…

items.title: CVE-2026-136796
items.summary: Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via an unbounded PBES2 iteration count. For a token using a PBES2 key management algorithm, decode_jwt passes the p2c header parameter to PBKDF2 as the iteration count without a range check, and derives the key before any integrity check. Unless accepted_alg rules it out, a token can select PBES2 whenever decode_jwt is given a symmetric key.

items.title: CVE-2026-136795
items.summary: Crypt::JWT versions before 0.037_1 for Perl allow memory exhaustion via unbounded inflation of zip DEF payloads. When a token header sets "zip" to "DEF", decode_jwt inflates the payload with no limit on the output size. A signed token is inflated after its signature verifies. An encrypted token is inflated after decryption, and with RSA-OAEP or ECDH-ES key management anyone who holds the recipient's public key can produce a token that decrypts.

items.title: CVE-2018-25445
items.summary: Crypt::JWT versions before 0.024 for Perl skip issuer, subject, audience and JWT ID checks when the claim is absent or the option is a plain string. decode_jwt runs the verify_iss, verify_sub, verify_aud and verify_jti checks only when the token carries the claim, and honours an option only as a Regexp or CODE reference. Any other value, such as verify_aud => 'myapp', is ignored. An application that relies on these checks accepts a validly signed token meant for a different issuer, subject or audience.

items.title: CVE-2026-116681
items.summary: NocoDB is software for building databases as spreadsheets. Prior to 2026.08.0, the row-scoped endpoints of a public shared view check whether a target record exists by primary key without applying the view's row filter, while the view's list and count endpoints do apply it. A recipient of a shared-view link, including its password where one is configured, can list the linked records of a filtered-out record and obtain signed download paths for its attachments by guessing its primary key. This issue is fixed in version 2026.08.0.

items.title: CVE-2026-81409
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the http-cisco-anyconnect.nse script and the anyconnect.lua library, whose redirect handler follows a server-supplied redirect target without checking that it stays on the scanned host. A malicious web server on a scanned host can redirect Nmap to an arbitrary host and port, including internal and loopback addresses the attacker cannot reach directly, making Nmap send a HEAD request followed by a POST request there; response content is not returned to the attacker. The script runs in the default script category (-sC, -A)…

items.title: CVE-2026-81407
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a hardcoded cryptographic key vulnerability in the DHCAST128 login of the NSE afp.lua library, which uses a fixed, publicly known Diffie-Hellman private exponent. A passive observer of the network traffic between Nmap and an Apple Filing Protocol server can compute the shared secret from the hardcoded exponent and the server's public value and decrypt the password supplied to scripts such as afp-showmount.nse and afp-brute.nse through the afp.username and afp.password arguments, without man-in-the-middle access or cryptanalysis.

items.title: CVE-2026-81417
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the dispatcher of the NSE tftp.lua library, which removes completed coroutines but not ones that ended in an error, leaving a zero-yield spin. A malicious TFTP exchange reached by snmp-ios-config.nse after an SNMP write sequence can leave a dead coroutine that freezes the entire Nmap invocation, before port scanning begins for any target in the run; the hang is prevented when the script-timeout option is set.

items.title: CVE-2026-81416
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the process_write function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose write loop does not advance when it processes a malformed Repeat to Address (RA) order. A malicious TN3270 server on a scanned host can embed a single 6-byte malformed RA order in an ordinary screen-write data stream after a normal negotiation, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process when tn3270-screen.nse runs, which the script-timeout option does not interrupt.

items.title: CVE-2026-81415
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the negotiate_tn3270 function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose device-type search loop does not advance when the server sends a protocol-conformant DEVICETYPE IS response without an LU suffix. A TN3270E server on a scanned host, including a non-malicious one that sends such a response, causes a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process when tn3270-screen.nse runs, which the script-timeout option does not interrupt.

items.title: CVE-2026-81412
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an excessive memory allocation vulnerability in the unmarshall_array function of the NSE msrpctypes.lua library, which trusts the entry count declared by the server. A malicious SMB server on a scanned host can declare an EntriesRead value of 0xFFFFFFFF with an empty buffer, causing a prolonged CPU spin and exhausting the memory of the Nmap process; the library is used by smb-enum-shares.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A).

items.title: CVE-2026-81411
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the ConfCreateResponse GCC block parser of the NSE rdp.lua library, which does not check that each block advances the read position. A malicious RDP server on a scanned host can include a single malformed zero-length block in an otherwise valid handshake, causing a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process that the script-timeout option does not interrupt; the library is used by rdp-enum-encryption.nse in the default script category (-sC, -A).

items.title: CVE-2026-81410
items.summary: Nmap before 7.992 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the broadcast-upnp-info.nse script and the upnp.lua library, which fetch the device description from the LOCATION URL in a UPnP response without checking that it points to the responding host. An attacker on the local network who answers the script's discovery broadcast can supply a LOCATION URL for an arbitrary host, port and path, including internal and loopback addresses, making Nmap send a GET request there; response content is not returned to the attacker.

items.title: CVE-2026-136721
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in coleifer peewee up to 4.5.3. This affects the function _print_table of the file pwiz.py of the component File Import Handler. This manipulation causes code injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The reported GitHub issue was closed with the reason "completed". However, it was not possible to determine the PR or commit which could have fixed this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-136329
items.summary: A flaw was found in the file-gif-load plugin in GIMP. When processing a specially crafted JIF image file, a 32-bit integer overflow occurs during the pixel buffer size calculation, while the zlib output limit is computed separately without wrapping. This leads to an undersized heap allocation, resulting in a heap-based buffer overflow when the compressed image data is decompressed. This issue can result in an application crash, leading to a denial of service, or potentially allow for arbitrary code execution.

items.title: CVE-2026-135140
items.summary: Mongoid may omit a field from the client-side encryption settings it generates for a collection when that same field is also used as a reference to another record. The value is then stored in readable form instead of encrypted, and the application receives no indication that this has happened. A party with ordinary authenticated read access to the affected collection may be able to view data that was intended to be protected.

items.title: CVE-2026-135139

Conditions already attached to the association can take precedence over the filter the caller supplied, so records the caller did not select may be removed. A user with basic privileges in an application built on the library may cause unintended removal of records belonging to the same parent record.

items.title: CVE-2026-135138
items.summary: Mongoid does not consistently apply its read-only attribute protection when attribute names are supplied dynamically by the caller. In an application that forwards caller-supplied attribute names into a document update, a user with basic application privileges may change values held inside a field the model declared immutable. This may result in unintended modification of data the application treats as trusted, such as flags used for its own access decisions.

items.title: CVE-2026-135135
items.summary: Mongoid builds an incomplete automatic encryption schema for certain embedded document associations. As a result, values that the application declared as encrypted may be written to the database in cleartext, with no error or warning returned to the application. A party holding only basic read privileges on the affected collection, and no access to the encryption keys, may then obtain those values in readable form.

items.title: CVE-2026-135225

A party able to read the application's error output or logs may thereby obtain database credential text together with deployment coordinates. The condition arises entirely within the embedding application process and requires no database authentication.

An application that relies on a relationship-absence query to restrict which records a request may see or change can therefore have that restriction silently fail, allowing a user with basic application privileges to read and to modify or remove records the restriction was meant to cover.

items.title: CVE-2026-135144

A user with basic application privileges may be able to read or change records that the application intended to keep out of reach.

items.title: CVE-2026-135142
items.summary: An incorrect authorization weakness in the embedded relation handling of the Laravel MongoDB library may allow a user with basic application privileges to alter records belonging to other users. After an embedded relation is pre-loaded, a routine write on that record is issued without the constraint that limits it to the record the user is permitted to change. This may result in unintended modification or loss of stored data for other users of the same application.
