items.summary: Joomla Extension - onlinecommunityhub.nl - Server-side request forgery via image check bypass in ochOpenGraph extension 1.0.0-3.1.0 - The image check meant to prevent server-side requests to internal addresses could be bypassed through a redirect, an internal IPv6 address or a remote image URL containing the site address, allowing content authors to make the server send requests to internal systems. Fixed in 3.1.1.

items.title: CVE-2026-136552
items.summary: A security vulnerability has been detected in Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11_multi. This impacts the function formSetIPv6status of the file /goform/setIPv6Status of the component multiWAN. Such manipulation of the argument remoteIP leads to command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-82359
items.summary: Cross Site Request Forgery protections are improperly configured in jspwiki.war in Apache JSPWIKI 3.0.0 on all platforms allows attacker to bypass protections for CSRF. A work around exists for existing deployments. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1 which fixes this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-78111
items.summary: Token Exposure in AttachmentTab.jsp in Apache JSPWIKI in the effected version on all platforms exposes the Cross Site Request Forgery protected token via the address bar. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1 which fixes this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-125741
items.summary: Cross Site Scripting (XSS) in ListLocksPlugin in Apache JSPWiki 2.10.2 through 3.0.0 on all platforms allows an attacker to execute javascript in the browser of a visitor of a page that uses the plugin. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1, which fixes this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-78114
items.summary: Session Fixation in the login flow of Apache JSPWiki versions 2.10 through 3.0.0 on all platforms. The session identifier was not replaced when a user authenticated, so an attacker who could set a known session identifier in the browser of a victim could use the same identifier after the victim logged in. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1 (3.x) or 2.12.6 (2.x), which fix this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-78099
items.summary: Cross Site Request Forgery in multiple components in Apache JSPWIKI on the specified versions on all platforms allows an attacker to bypass CSRF protections under specific conditions and http methods. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1, which fixes this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-78098
items.summary: Wiki page level access control list bypass in Apache JSPWIKI versions prior to 3.0.1 on all platforms allows an attacker to bypass page level access controls through a specifically crafted wiki page. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1 which fixes this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-125949
items.summary: Cross Site Scripting (XSS) in the Markdown renderer of Apache JSPWiki 2.11.0 through 3.0.0 on all platforms, when the Markdown syntax is enabled, allows an attacker who can edit a page to execute javascript in the browser of a visitor of that page. The text and the url of an inline image were written into the attributes of the img element without encoding. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1, which fixes this issue. A fix was also backported to 2.12.6

items.title: CVE-2026-78110
items.summary: Cascading Style Sheet injection in Image plugin in Apache JSPWIKI versions 2.1.4 through 3.0.0 on all platforms allows an authenticated attacker to edit an page and fool users into clickjacking/phishing attacks. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1, which fixes this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-134792
items.summary: When the proxy option isn't set, HttpClient takes the proxy from environment variables like http_proxy or HTTP_PROXY. On web servers, it ignores HTTP_PROXY, because PHP puts the Proxy request header there (the httpoxy issue). On the CLI SAPI, it read HTTP_PROXY from $_SERVER, where PHP also puts the environment. HTTP workers that run under the CLI SAPI put the headers of each request in $_SERVER too. This is the case of spiral/roadrunner-http, which the RoadRunner runner of php-runtime uses, and of baldinof/roadrunner-bundle and php-pm. A client could then send a Proxy header to choose the pro…

items.title: CVE-2026-134791
items.summary: Since Symfony 7.2, expressions can contain comments. The lexer used a regular expression to find the end of a comment. When a /* was never closed, this regular expression scanned the rest of the expression, and the lexer then went on with the next character. So each /* scanned the rest of the expression again. Linting 192 KB of /* took 9 to 11 seconds, and 96 KB took 34 seconds without PCRE JIT. The lexer runs before the parser and its nesting limit. Any code that lints or parses untrusted expressions is affected, including the ExpressionSyntax validation constraint. A Length constraint on the…

items.title: CVE-2026-133762
items.summary: Since Symfony 7.4.0, FrameworkBundle chooses the error renderer from the runtime mode of the application, which comes from the APP_RUNTIME_MODE env var. When this variable isn't set, the cli, phpdbg and embed SAPIs default to the CLI mode, and errors are rendered with CliErrorRenderer. This renderer dumps the whole exception, and it did so even when debug was off. HTTP workers that run under the CLI SAPI and don't set APP_RUNTIME_MODE then sent these dumps as error responses in production. They contain the messages, file paths and traces of the exceptions. Some exceptions reference the request…

items.title: CVE-2026-133761
items.summary: CsvEncoder::decode() splits each header cell on the key separator, . by default, and nests the decoded rows one level per separator, with no limit. PHP frees nested arrays recursively, so freeing data that is nested deeply enough overflows the C stack and crashes the process. With a stack of 8 MB, a CSV body of 448 KB is enough. Each row also builds all the levels of its headers again. With a deep header, a CSV body of 2 KB made of short rows allocates more than 128 MB. A body of 1 MB keeps the CPU busy for 10 seconds or more. Any code that decodes untrusted CSV with the Serializer is affected…

items.title: CVE-2026-133759
items.summary: DoctrineTokenProvider keeps a copy of the previous token of a remember-me cookie. This way, concurrent requests sent with that token are still accepted for 60 seconds. The copy is stored in another row, under a series derived from the series of the cookie. Since Symfony 6.4.45, 7.4.18 and 8.1.6, a copy is stored for every series that the remember-me handler generates. Before, copies were stored only for the series created before Symfony 5.4.19, 6.0.19, 6.1.11 and 6.2.5. A cookie could use the series of the copy instead of its own series. The copy then matched as a current token, so the limit o…

items.title: CVE-2026-133758
items.summary: Since Symfony 5.4.48, 6.4.16, 7.1.9 and 7.2.0, NoPrivateNetworkHttpClient prepares each request with the default options of the library. The decorator then passes all these options to the decorated client. Every option is then already set, so that client ignores its own default options. When these defaults restrict TLS trust, the restriction is lost without any error. A client created with peer_fingerprint, a private cafile or a minimum crypto_method refuses a server on its own. Once decorated, the same client connects to that server. Someone on the network path with a certificate that the sys…

items.title: CVE-2026-133757
items.summary: Since Symfony 5.4.48, 6.4.16, 7.1.9 and 7.2.0, NoPrivateNetworkHttpClient follows redirects itself, and sends each hop as a new request through the client it decorates. Before a redirect to another origin, it removes the Authorization and Cookie headers it knows about. But the decorated client then added its own default options again. These include the auth_basic, auth_bearer and auth_ntlm credentials, and the Authorization and Cookie headers it was created with. Credentials set with withOptions() on the decorator came back the same way, since the decorator forwards them to the decorated clien…

items.title: CVE-2026-133755
items.summary: Since Symfony 7.3, the require_tls option of EsmtpTransport refuses to send a message over a connection that isn't encrypted. It prevents a network attacker from stripping STARTTLS. But after the server's 220 reply to STARTTLS, the transport started the TLS handshake without checking whether more data had already arrived. An attacker in the middle of the connection could add cleartext replies right after the 220. The transport then read them as if they came from the encrypted session. The attacker could make the transport skip AUTH, or report a message as sent while the server had rejected it.…

items.title: CVE-2026-133754
items.summary: UrlGenerator puts the values of host placeholders into the generated URL without encoding them. Their default requirement, [^.]++, accepts /, @, #, ?, \, % and :. With the host {tenant}.example.com, the value evil%2Ecom# gives https://evil%2Ecom#.example.com/dashboard, which browsers send to evil.com. This works even when requirements are checked. Unicode full stops like 。 have the same effect, since IDNA maps them to .. Applications are exposed when untrusted values reach host placeholders, for example when they pass the query string of the request to url(). A route that uses RedirectControll…

items.title: CVE-2026-133752
items.summary: When it denormalizes data into a class, the Serializer computes which attributes it may write from the #[Ignore] and #[Groups] metadata. It did that for the requested class, but wrote into another class in two cases. The first case is the class that a discriminator map picks from the data. The second is the class of the object passed with the object_to_populate or deep_object_to_populate option. When the requested class has no #[Ignore] attribute and the context sets no groups, nothing was restricted. A client could then set a property that the picked class marks with #[Ignore], constructor ar…

items.title: CVE-2026-133751
items.summary: Since Symfony 7.3, the require_tls option of EsmtpTransport refuses to send a message over a connection that isn't encrypted. It prevents a network attacker from stripping STARTTLS. But when the server rejected the EHLO command, the transport fell back to HELO and skipped that check. An attacker in the middle of an SMTP connection that uses STARTTLS could answer EHLO with an error and HELO with a success. The transport then sent the sender, the recipients and the whole message in cleartext, and reported success. No AUTH command is sent on that path, so credentials don't leak. Connections that…

items.title: CVE-2026-133750
items.summary: Since Symfony 7.4, CachingHttpClient can cache the responses of HTTP clients, for example when caching is enabled in framework.http_client. Its withOptions() method passes the options to the decorated client only. So credentials set with withOptions(), like auth_bearer, auth_basic, an Authorization header or a Cookie header, reach the server, but CachingHttpClient doesn't see them. They're missing from the cache key. They also miss the rule that keeps a shared cache from storing the responses to requests with an Authorization header. A cacheable response fetched for one user is then served to…

items.title: CVE-2026-133749
items.summary: GuardAuthenticatorHandler::authenticateUserAndHandleSuccess() logs a user in programmatically with a Guard authenticator, for example in the registration controllers that MakerBundle generated. This method creates the token and stores it, but it calls neither checkPreAuth() nor checkPostAuth() on the user checker of the firewall. Guard authenticators run both checks when they authenticate a request. As a consequence, an account that a user checker rejects in checkPostAuth() could still be logged in through this method, for example an expired account. Applications are affected when they use Gua…

items.title: CVE-2026-133748
items.summary: NoPrivateNetworkHttpClient accepts a list of subnets to block instead of its default one. When that list contains an IPv6 entry, the client lets IpUtils::checkIp() decide for every address. Before Symfony 6.4.50, 7.4.23 and 8.1.11, checkIp() didn't match an IPv4-mapped address like ::ffff:127.0.0.1 against IPv4 subnets. Such an address connects to the IPv4 host it embeds. So http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]/, or a host name whose AAAA record contains a mapped address, reaches a blocked IPv4 host: $client = new NoPrivateNetworkHttpClient(HttpClient::create(), ['10.0.0.0/8', '127.0.0.0/8', '192.168.0.0…

items.title: CVE-2026-133747
items.summary: Since Symfony 7.4, framework.http_client.scoped_clients can enable caching on a scoped client. FrameworkBundle then puts a CachingHttpClient inside the ScopingHttpClient, with the options of the scope as default options. CachingHttpClient merges them into every request. So the credentials of the scope, like auth_bearer, auth_basic or an Authorization header, are also sent to URLs outside the scope: framework: http_client: scoped_clients: github.client: base_uri: 'https://api.github.com' headers: { Authorization: 'token GH-SECRET' } caching: { enabled: true } $githubClient->request('GET', 'http…

items.title: CVE-2026-133745
items.summary: The router redirects a request to the same URL with or without its trailing slash, or with the scheme that a route requires. To do so, the matcher returns RedirectController::urlRedirectAction() with the path info of the request as path. Since Symfony 5.4.44, 6.4.12 and 7.1.5, urlRedirectAction() turns a path that starts with // into ://..., so that protocol-relative targets configured in routes work. The path info of a request starts with // when its URI does. So these redirects send the browser to the host written at the start of the path: GET https://app.example//evil.example/edit/ => 301 L…

items.title: CVE-2026-122121
items.summary: Cross Site Scripting (XSS) in 2.10 Legacy Theming in Apache JSPWIKI version 2.10.0 through 3.0.0 on all platforms allows specially crafted filenames of uploaded attachments to potentially render unescaped html or javascript to the browser. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1, which fixes this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-136680
items.summary: Reachable Assertion vulnerability in Samsung Open Source Walrus allows Input Data Manipulation.

items.title: CVE-2026-136679
items.summary: NULL Pointer Dereference vulnerability in Samsung Open Source Walrus allows Input Data Manipulation.

items.title: CVE-2026-78105
items.summary: Cross Site Scripting/injection in WYSIWYG editor in Apache JSPWIKI from 2.10 through 3.0.0 on all platforms allows attacker to inject html or javascript outside of the textarea bounds used for rendering. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1, which fixes this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-134649
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in logrotate/force.cgi that prints logrotate -f diagnostic output without HTML escaping. Local OS users can create files with script-laden names in wildcard-rotated log directories, executing script in the Webmin session when Force Log Rotation is clicked.

items.title: CVE-2026-134632
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability that allows man-in-the-middle attackers to capture credentials because servers/save_serv.cgi skips the selected SSL certificate check. When fast RPC is set to Automatic, attackers intercepting the /fastrpc.cgi probe can obtain the remote Webmin username and password sent via HTTP Basic Authorization.

items.title: CVE-2026-134439
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject scripts by supplying values from managed hosts that cluster modules render unescaped. Attackers who can edit a Servers Index description, control a managed host, or intercept its RPC link can inject server descriptions, versions, user/group names, or package fields to execute JavaScript in the central administrator's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134365
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows on-path network attackers to inject script by tampering with plaintext HTTP search results rendered unescaped. Attackers who intercept rpmfind.net or Google responses can inject autofocus/onfocus payloads that execute in a logged-in user's browser within the Webmin origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-136547
items.summary: A vulnerability was determined in Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11_multi. Impacted is the function R7WebsSecurityHandler of the component httpd. Executing a manipulation can lead to improper authentication. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

items.title: CVE-2026-136624
items.summary: lightNVR before 0.44.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in go2rtc_proxy_authorize_request() that allows authenticated users to access restricted cameras by exploiting inconsistent src parameter parsing. Attackers can percent-encode a second src parameter name or exceed the 255-byte truncation so go2rtc resolves a different camera, obtaining unauthorized snapshots and HLS live streams.

items.title: Aggressive SSH Scanning from 109.160.32.0/24; VMware VMSA-2026-0011 vCenter Auth Bypass (CVE-2026-123903) (Nov 25th 2026)
items.summary: Today's episode covers aggressive SSH brute-force scanning from 109.160.32.0/24 against DShield honeypots, Broadcom's critical VMSA-2026-0011 advisory for vCenter, ESX, Workstation, Fusion, and Avi Load Balancer, and a reminder that DShield was first put together on Thanksgiving 2000. Scanning from Subnet 109.160.32.0/24 Guy Bruneau describes SSH brute-force scanning from 109.160.32.0/24, a Romanian VPS range, with 127 unique addresses hitting one DShield sensor and 134 hitting the other; successful logins typically ran uname and then disconnected. Many of the scans began with a static IP ID a…
items.source: SANS Internet Stormcenter Daily Cyber Security Podcast (Stormcast)

items.title: CVE-2026-132145
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When using the Datagram Transport Layer Security (DTLS) output module (omdtls) configured to authenticate receivers by name or fingerprint, the module validates the certificate chain against trusted certificate authorities but fails to verify that the certificate matches the intended receiver's identity or fingerprint. An attacker who can redirect or intercept outbound network traffic and present a certificate issued by a trusted certificate authority could capture forwarded log data, leading to information disclosure.

items.title: CVE-2026-134650
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in useradmin/edit_user.cgi that displays home directory paths without HTML escaping to users with the autohome ACL. A Webmin user with broader Users and Groups rights can store a home path containing script via save_user.cgi, executing it in a restricted sub-administrator's Webmin session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134647
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in web-lib-funcs.pl and fastrpc.cgi that sends cluster RPC traffic over raw TCP despite SSL configuration. Network-positioned attackers can read the session ID and remote_eval payloads or alter calls in transit to execute code as root on managed servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134646
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in the SMTP service monitor that never issues STARTTLS because get_smtp_status tests an undefined $ssl variable. Passive network attackers can capture AUTH PLAIN credentials sent in plaintext each time a STARTTLS-configured monitor runs, without needing a Webmin login.

items.title: CVE-2026-134645
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in proc/trace.cgi that allows local unprivileged OS users to inject markup via unescaped process arguments and system call parameters. Attackers can craft process command lines or file names passed to open so that script executes in a Webmin user's session when they trace the process.

items.title: CVE-2026-134641
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in minecraft/save_backup.cgi that allows local attackers with write access to the Minecraft server directory to inject script via unescaped world directory names. Attackers can create a world directory containing HTML or script that executes in a Webmin user's session when they run Backup Now.

items.title: CVE-2026-134640
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in imap_login in mailboxes/folders-lib.pl that skips certificate verification and hostname checks for IMAP SSL connections. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate to capture IMAP credentials sent by the System and Server Status IMAP monitor and spoof monitor results.

items.title: CVE-2026-134638
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing integrity verification vulnerability in usermin/upgrade.cgi that downloads Usermin upgrade packages over plaintext HTTP without signature or digest checks. On-path network attackers or DNS spoofers can supply a malicious RPM, Debian, or tar.gz package whose maintainer scripts or setup.sh execute as root during upgrade.

items.title: CVE-2026-134637
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a STARTTLS downgrade vulnerability in send_mail in mailboxes/boxes-lib.pl that continues over plaintext when STARTTLS is rejected. Man-in-the-middle attackers can strip or reject STARTTLS to capture configured SMTP AUTH credentials, crackable CRAM-MD5 exchanges, and the content of sent mail.

items.title: CVE-2026-134636
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a weak randomness vulnerability that allows attackers to predict TOTP two-factor secrets generated by generate_base32_secret() using a time and PID seeded rand(). Attackers who know a user's password and estimate enrollment time can enumerate candidate seeds, reproduce the secret, and bypass the second authentication factor.

items.title: CVE-2026-134635
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in ldap-client/check.cgi that allows LDAP directory writers to execute commands via unquoted uid values. Attackers can create a posixAccount entry with shell metacharacters in its uid, executing commands as root when an administrator runs Check Configuration.

items.title: CVE-2026-134634
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in servers/link.cgi that accepts self-signed certificates for linked servers even when certificate checking is enabled. Man-in-the-middle attackers presenting a self-signed certificate with the correct hostname can capture stored HTTP Basic credentials for the remote Webmin and inject HTML into the local Webmin origin.

items.title: CVE-2026-134633
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in init/mass_systemd.cgi that prints unescaped journalctl output when a systemd service fails to start. Attackers can inject script into the journal via logger or sshd invalid user names, executing it in an administrator's Webmin session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134631
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-useradmin/edit_user.cgi that allows attackers to inject markup through the LDAP sambaAcctFlags and sambaBadPasswordCount attributes, which are rendered without HTML encoding. Attackers with LDAP write access to these attributes can store malicious scripts that execute in a Webmin administrator's browser when the user entry is opened in the editor.

items.title: CVE-2026-134629
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in mysql/index.cgi that renders MySQL connection error text and server version strings without escaping. Malicious MySQL server operators or on-path attackers on plaintext connections can return markup in error packets or version strings to execute JavaScript in Webmin user sessions.

items.title: CVE-2026-134628
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Disk Quotas module that allows directory administrators to inject markup via NSS user names. Attackers who can create or rename LDAP, NIS or SSSD identities owning blocks on XFS quota filesystems can execute script in the browser of administrators viewing quota/list_users.cgi.

items.title: CVE-2026-134627
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows local users or directory writers to inject script by placing markup in user names, group names or GECOS fields. Attackers can set GECOS via chfn or modify LDAP, NIS or SSSD entries so unescaped values in my_user_chooser.cgi, my_group_chooser.cgi, user_chooser.cgi and group_chooser.cgi execute in a Webmin user's browser.

items.title: CVE-2026-134463
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in switch_smtp_to_ssl in mailboxes/boxes-lib.pl and status/smtp-monitor.pl, which calls Net::SSLeay::connect without certificate verification or a hostname check. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate when SMTP with SSL or STARTTLS is configured to capture SMTP AUTH credentials and message content.

items.title: CVE-2026-134462
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in mount/nfs_export.cgi that allows malicious NFS servers to inject scripts through unescaped export paths. Attackers controlling or spoofing an NFS server's mountd replies can return crafted export paths that execute JavaScript in the session of a Webmin user browsing exports.

items.title: CVE-2026-134446
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a weak random password generation vulnerability in generate_random_password() that allows attackers to predict generated account passwords because seed_random() effectively seeds Perl rand() with only time XOR process ID. When the non-default random_password option is enabled and administrators keep the pre-filled password in edit_user.cgi, attackers can enumerate time and PID seeds to recover passwords and authenticate as new accounts.

items.title: CVE-2026-134445
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in status/edit_mon.cgi that allows attackers to inject scripts through unescaped monitor status descriptions. Malicious HTTP or FTPS server operators, on-path attackers, or local users creating crafted filenames in wildcard-monitored directories can execute JavaScript in a Webmin user's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134444
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in connect_ldap_db in ldap-server/ldap-server-lib.pl that sends the LDAP root DN password unencrypted when encryption is set to Detect automatically. Passive network attackers observing traffic between Webmin and a remote LDAP server can capture directory root credentials because the connection loop always reaches a plaintext bind attempt.

items.title: CVE-2026-134442
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-client/popup_browser.cgi that allows attackers to inject markup by storing it in LDAP attribute values printed without HTML encoding. Attackers with write access to an LDAP directory entry, needing no Webmin account, can execute scripts in the Webmin origin when an administrator browses that entry.

items.title: CVE-2026-134441
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Upload and Download module that allows attackers to inject script via unescaped HTTP status lines from background downloads. Attackers controlling a download server can return a malicious status line stored by updown/download.pl and printed unescaped by updown/index.cgi, executing script in a higher-privileged user's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134440
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a Perl code injection vulnerability in cluster-useradmin/sync.cgi that allows attackers to run code by placing single quotes in home directory paths. Attackers with root on one managed host can craft a home path that breaks out of remote_eval() string literals during Sync, executing Perl as root on other managed hosts.

items.title: CVE-2026-134438
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an insecure download vulnerability in webmin/upgrade.cgi, cluster-webmin/upgrade.cgi and cluster-usermin/upgrade.cgi that fetches upgrade packages over plaintext HTTP with GnuPG signature verification disabled by default. On-path network attackers can substitute a malicious RPM, Debian or tar.gz package during a default upgrade to execute code as root on the Webmin host and managed cluster servers.

items.title: CVE-2026-134437
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-server/edit_browser.cgi that allows attackers with write access to LDAP entry attributes to inject script by storing markup in attribute values. When an administrator browses the entry in the LDAP Server directory browser, the unencoded script runs in the Webmin origin, letting attackers act with the administrator's session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134368
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in lpadmin/list_jobs.cgi that allows local users or network IPP clients to inject script via CUPS print-job titles. Attackers can submit a print job with a crafted title, for example using lp -t, to execute script in a Printer Administration user's Webmin session.

items.title: CVE-2026-134333
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in mysql/view_table.cgi that allows MySQL users to inject scripts via unescaped column names. Attackers with CREATE or ALTER privilege can create columns containing HTML payloads that execute in a Webmin administrator's session when the table is viewed.

items.title: CVE-2026-134326
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a signature verification bypass vulnerability in webmin-lib.pl that allows attackers to install unsigned module updates when GnuPG setup fails. Attackers tampering with update downloads via network position or a custom update URL can supply malicious modules that run as root when administrators apply updates.

items.title: CVE-2026-134323
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in generic_ldap_connect in ldap-client-lib.pl that accepts any LDAPS or StartTLS server certificate. Man-in-the-middle attackers can impersonate the LDAP server to capture the bind DN password, often the root DN, and return forged directory data.

items.title: CVE-2026-134305
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-useradmin/raw.cgi that allows attackers with LDAP attribute write access to inject markup. Attackers can store script in user or group attributes or the dn, which executes in an administrator's browser when viewing the raw entry.

items.title: CVE-2026-134283
items.summary: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the http_download function of web-lib-funcs.pl that skips TLS chain and hostname verification. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate and substitute downloaded modules, themes, or catalog content, leading to root code execution or injected HTML.

items.title: CVE-2026-136632
items.summary: OpenProject 17.2.0 before 17.5.2, 17.6.0 before 17.6.1, 17.7.0 before 17.7.3, 17.8.0 before 17.8.2, and 17.9.0 before 17.9.7 contains an externally controlled method selection vulnerability in InplaceEditFieldsController via the unvalidated attribute parameter. Users who can view a project can request the inplace_edit_fields reset route with attribute destroy to delete projects and subprojects, or invoke other methods exposing restricted data.

items.title: CVE-2026-136629
items.summary: Nektos act 0.2.92 before 0.2.95 contains an argument injection vulnerability in readProjectArgsFile and projectFlag that allows malicious repositories to bypass the untrusted project .actrc flag allowlist. Attackers can commit a crafted .actrc smuggling disallowed flags like -P self-hosted or --privileged to run workflow steps on the developer's host.

items.title: CVE-2026-136625
items.summary: ai-memory 2.6.0 before 3.3.2 contains a symlink following vulnerability in the ai-memory-wikisync companion that allows local attackers to overwrite arbitrary files by planting symlinks at predictable temporary names. Attackers can place a .wikisync-tmp-.md symlink in a shared destination so atomic_write() truncates and overwrites its target with the victim's privileges.

items.title: CVE-2026-136621
items.summary: LTplus-AG ifc-lite @ifc-lite/export before 4.13.1 and ifc-lite-export before 27.0.0 contain a STEP record injection vulnerability in the mutation writer via unescaped typed-value type names. Attackers controlling the mutations payload can place parentheses, semicolons, and newlines in typed.type to append arbitrary entity records to exported IFC files, bypassing the class-name guard.

items.title: CVE-2026-136620
items.summary: pain001-mcp 0.0.72 before 0.0.80 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the commit_payment_batch MCP tool that allows attackers to write files outside any output directory via output_file_path. Attackers can stage a batch, reuse the self-issued confirmation_token, and supply absolute, dot-dot, or symlinked paths to create or overwrite server-writable files with generated XML.

items.title: CVE-2026-136619
items.summary: Karakeep before 0.35.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows shared-list collaborators to learn other users' private favourited and archived bookmark state through filter queries. Viewer or editor collaborators can call bookmarks.getBookmarks on a shared list with favourited or archived set to true, inferring owners' private flags from which bookmarks buildCommonFilters returns.

items.title: CVE-2026-136618
items.summary: Karakeep before 0.35.0 contains an improper access control vulnerability in ManualList.mergeInto that allows list owners to retain collaborator bookmarks by merging shared lists without ownership checks. Owners invoking the lists.merge tRPC procedure create rows not tied to collaborator membership, preserving read access to collaborator bookmarks and assets after the collaborator's access is revoked.

items.title: CVE-2026-136617
items.summary: Shopify async-memcached before 0.11.0 contains a command injection vulnerability in Client::validate_meta_flags that allows attackers to inject extra memcached meta protocol tokens via whitespace in flags. Attackers controlling part of a meta flag can add quiet, opaque, mode or size override tokens to alter operations and desynchronize responses on shared connections.

items.title: CVE-2026-136616
items.summary: COVESA Open1722 before 0.9.8 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Avtp_Vss_CalcVssPathLength in src/avtp/acf/custom/Vss.c, which reads the INTEROP path-length prefix without checking the declared ACF message length. Attackers can send header-only 12-byte INTEROP-mode VSS frames to trigger reads past the buffer, or prefix values 0xFFFE and 0xFFFF that wrap uint16 lengths and cause Avtp_Vss_SetVssData to overwrite the path area.

items.title: CVE-2026-136615
items.summary: league/commonmark 2.6.0 before 2.10.8 contains a denial of service vulnerability in DelimiterStack::push() that miscounts delimiter runs against the max_delimiters_per_line budget. Attackers submitting Markdown with two long emphasis character runs can produce deeply nested strong elements, causing quadratic rendering time and CPU exhaustion.

items.title: CVE-2026-136451
items.summary: A flaw was found in the Keycloak Operator. Deterministic hashes derived from Kubernetes Secrets are published in generated StatefulSet metadata and in KeycloakOIDCClient status. A user with read access to those resources may be able to recover a low-entropy credential referenced by a Secret, even when Kubernetes RBAC denies the user access to the Secret itself.

items.title: CVE-2026-136448
items.summary: A vulnerability was identified in nliautaud pico-content-editor up to 02d5ad6c820c5050c542ab9505819b5e0a0ba1af. Affected by this vulnerability is the function Uploads::saveFile/Auth::init of the file src/Uploads.php of the component Authorization Subsystem. Such manipulation of the argument PicoContentEditorUpload leads to unrestricted upload. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. This product operates on a rolling release basis, ensuring continuous delivery. Consequently, there are no version details for either affected or updated releases.…

items.title: CVE-2026-124606
items.summary: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory Vulnerability in Cosminexus Component Container. This issue affects Cosminexus Component Container: from 11-20 before 11-70-04.

items.title: CVE-2026-136447
items.summary: A vulnerability was found in browser-use 0.13.13/0.13.14. This impacts the function load_and_migrate_config of the file browser_use/config.py of the component SecurityWatchdog. The manipulation results in improper authorization. The attack requires a local approach. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

items.title: CVE-2026-135813
items.summary: A flaw was found in Red Hat Enterprise Linux's qemu-kvm virtualization software. A privileged user inside a guest virtual machine could use this flaw to make the host QEMU process copy parts of its own memory into the guest's memory, where the attacker could read it. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to view portions of the host QEMU process memory from within a guest, potentially exposing sensitive information that could aid in further attacks. The highest threat from this vulnerability is to confidentiality.

items.title: CVE-2026-136446
items.summary: A vulnerability has been found in JaguarJack catch-admin up to 5.4.1. This affects the function update of the file modules/Permissions/Http/Controllers/RolesController.php. The manipulation leads to dynamically-determined object attributes. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The identifier of the patch is 3ae60d57ea6840bb33456596ad799b0a39ca94a2. It is recommended to apply a patch to fix this issue.

items.title: CVE-2026-132074
items.summary: The WP Page Builder WordPress plugin through 1.2.8 does not check that the user has permission to edit the targeted post before switching which editor's content is rendered for it, allowing users with a role as low as Subscriber to change what any post or page displays, by switching it between its normal content and its stored page builder content.

items.title: CVE-2026-132048
items.summary: The WP Meta SEO WordPress plugin through 4.5.18 does not check that the user is allowed to edit the post or comment containing an indexed link before rewriting or removing that link, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to change the target and text of links in, or strip links from, any post or comment.

items.title: CVE-2026-132047
items.summary: The WP Page Builder WordPress plugin through 1.2.8 does not check capabilities or nonces in one of its AJAX actions, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to read, add, overwrite and delete the builder's saved sections, and to store arbitrary HTML that is rendered unescaped to an administrator who opens a crafted link.

items.title: CVE-2026-132046
items.summary: The WP Page Builder WordPress plugin through 1.2.8 does not sanitise and escape some of its layout settings before outputting them in pages, and does not check that the user may edit the post being saved, allowing users with a role as low as Contributor to inject stored Cross-Site Scripting payloads into any post or page, including ones they cannot edit.

items.title: CVE-2026-136550
items.summary: A weakness has been identified in Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11_multi. This affects the function fromAdvSetMacMtuWan of the file /goform/AdvSetMacMtuWan. This manipulation of the argument mac causes command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-136549
items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11_multi. The impacted element is the function formSetSafeWanWebMan of the file /goform/SetRemoteWebCfg. The manipulation of the argument remoteIp results in command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

items.title: CVE-2026-126536
items.summary: Akaunting 3.3.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the XLSX tax-import workflow. An authenticated Manager can import HTML in a tax name and associate the tax with an item. When an Administrator attempts to disable that tax, Akaunting renders the original stored name in an error notification through Vue v-html, causing attacker-controlled markup to execute within the browser of another authenticated user.

items.title: CVE-2026-130336
items.summary: Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection') in the HWBridge custom methods command dispatcher (lib/rex/post/hwbridge/ui/console/command_dispatcher/custom_methods.rb) in Rapid7 Metasploit Framework versions prior to 6.5.10 on all platforms allows a malicious or compromised hardware bridge to execute arbitrary code in the msfconsole process via a crafted method_name returned by the /custom_methods endpoint. The injected code runs automatically when the operator connects to the bridge, without the operator invoking any custom command.

items.title: CVE-2026-136628
items.summary: Wails before 2.17.1 on Linux contains an origin validation error in the sendMessageToBackend WebKitGTK handler that allows child-frame scripts to invoke the privileged IPC channel. Attackers controlling content loaded in an iframe can post messages that pass the top-level URI origin check and call bound Go methods and Wails runtime operations.

items.title: CVE-2026-129839
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When processing log entries using certain JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) formatting templates, the service fails to properly escape input composed entirely of quotation marks or backslashes. An attacker who can supply logged input can exploit this issue to generate malformed JSON output, which may cause downstream log ingestion systems and parsers to reject log records.

items.title: CVE-2026-129832
items.summary: A flaw was found in rsyslog. When process identification (PID) rewriting is enabled in the imuxsock module, a local attacker with access to the logging socket can send a crafted log message with an empty tag. This triggers an invalid memory write, causing the logging service to crash and resulting in a Denial of Service (DoS).

items.title: CVE-2026-135328
items.summary: A flaw was found in kubevirt Containerized Data Importer (CDI). The CDI clone controller derives the CommonName of a CDI-CA-signed upload client certificate from the tenant-settable cdi.kubevirt.io/uploadClientName PVC annotation without validation, and the upload server authenticates clients only by certificate CA chain and CommonName string match, with no namespace or PVC binding. A namespace user can obtain a valid client certificate and write arbitrary data into any upload-ready PVC in any namespace whose upload Service is reachable from the cluster network, resulting in cross-namespace in…

items.title: CVE-2026-125734
items.summary: A flaw was found in GStreamer gst-plugins-bad mxfdemux handling of MXF Index Table Segment data. Crafted index metadata can lead to an out-of-range lookup during a seek and terminate the media process. A Fedora 43 test reproduced an assertion-triggered abort. The upstream advisory also notes possible information disclosure, but an attacker-visible leak has not been demonstrated.

items.title: CVE-2026-136445
items.summary: A flaw has been found in JaguarJack catch-admin up to 5.4.1. The impacted element is the function store of the file modules/Permissions/Http/Controllers/RolesController.php. Executing a manipulation can lead to dynamically-determined object attributes. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. This patch is called 3ae60d57ea6840bb33456596ad799b0a39ca94a2. It is best practice to apply a patch to resolve this issue.

An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications using PyJWT to fail unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service. If an application reused that mapping for a later call with signature verification enabled, an attacker could possibly use this issue to bypass token claim checks, such as expiration. items.title: USN-9203-1: libpcap vulnerabilities
items.summary: Jin Wei, Kunwei Qian, and Ping Chen discovered that libpcap did not properly validate the format of MAC addresses passed to the pcap_ether_aton() function, leading to an out-of-bounds read and write. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications using libpcap to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. This issue only affected Ubuntu 22.04 LTS and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. (CVE-2025-11961) It was discovered that the libpcap remote capture (rpcap) client did not properly validate packet messages received from the server. A malicious server could pos…

items.title: USN-9200-1: elfutils vulnerabilities
items.summary: It was discovered that elfutils incorrectly handled memory when processing certain malformed DWARF data. If a user or automated system were tricked into running readelf on a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause readelf to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2025-1352) It was discovered that strip from elfutils could be made to dereference invalid memory when processing certain sections without data. If a user or automated system were tricked into running strip on a specially crafted file, an attacker could possibly use…

items.summary: Adam Bedard discovered that libXrender incorrectly handled certain responses from an X server, resulting in a heap buffer overflow. If a user were tricked into connecting to a malicious X server, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications using libXrender to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or execute arbitrary code. items.title: CVE-2026-71410 Use-After-Free in GNU Screen
items.summary: GNU Screen is vulnerable to a Use-After-Free in the utf8handlecomb function in encoding.c. Due to improper error handling during memory allocation failure, the global combchars pointer is freed but not reset to NULL. When a subsequent combining Unicode character arrives at the terminal, the function dereferences the freed pointer. An attacker who controls terminal content sent to the screen session, such as via a rogue SSH server or crafted escape sequences, can exploit this vulnerability to perform heap grooming and achieve arbitrary code execution. This issue was fixed in version 5.0.2...

items.summary: ピーチは11月26日、以前利用していたプレイドのサービスKARTEから顧客情報が漏えいしたと発表した。契約終了後も削除すべきデータが残っていた。四国電力でも退会済みの会員などの情報流出が新たに判明した。

items.title: 英国の入国審査システムHelios、誤情報の訂正体制に不備。内務省をけん責
items.summary: 英国の入国審査システムHeliosの導入時、誤った個人情報を現場から訂正につなげる手続きが整っていなかった。データ保護当局のICOは内務省の法令違反を認定し、誤情報による不当な拘束や入国拒否の危険を指摘した。

items.title: EUチャットコントロール恒久法案、議長国が議会の会派トップとの協議を計画か
items.summary: 児童性的虐待対策を巡るEUの恒久法案の交渉が難航している。欧州議会の担当報告者との妥協を他会派の交渉担当者が支持せず、議長国アイルランドは会派トップを協議に加える方針を示したとされる。私的な通信の検査条件と対象範囲が争点になっている。

items.title: AIが通話中に詐欺の兆候を検知、家族にも通知する電話アプリ「みやブルフォン」提供開始
items.summary: BBSSが特殊詐欺対策電話アプリ「みやブルフォン」の提供を始めた。AIが通話内容をリアルタイムで解析し、詐欺の可能性を検知すると通話中の本人と事前に登録した家族などに知らせる。離れて暮らす家族も状況確認に加われる。

items.title: Syncthing、同期相手の探索を分散化する案。対応可能なPCも探索を支える
items.summary: ファイル同期ソフトSyncthingでDHT（分散ハッシュテーブル）による端末探索の分散化が提案された。中央の探索サーバーへの依存を減らし、サーバー役を担えるPCなども探索網を支える設計を示している。

items.title: BeeStation OS 1.5.6-68000を段階配信、保存ファイルに関わる重大な脆弱性を修正
items.summary: SynologyがBeeStation OS 1.5.6-68000の段階配信を開始した。ファイルの不正な読み書きやサービス停止につながるおそれのある脆弱性を修正しており、利用者は適用済みのOSのバージョンを確認しておきたい。

items.title: Bitwarden 2026.11.0の拡張機能でログイン・自動入力に不具合。ロック連動を一時停止
items.summary: Bitwardenはブラウザー拡張機能の一部利用者でログインや保管庫のロック・解除、自動入力に不具合が生じていることを認めた。修正が用意できるまでアプリ間のロック連動機能を停止した。利用者からは症状が続く例も報告されている。

items.title: Character.AIの会話履歴を含む資産売却計画、米司法長官42人が異議
items.summary: 破産手続き中のCharacter.AI運営会社の資産売却計画に米41州とワシントンD.C.の司法長官が異議を申し立てた。利用者の私的な会話やAIの学習用データも売却対象に含まれ、買い手に個人情報の保護義務を課すよう求めている。

items.title: 国内のダークパターン対策、解約妨害の規制を検討。行政のAI活用も提案
items.summary: 意図しない定期購入や解約の妨害を防ぐため、国内でダークパターンへの規制強化が検討されている。企業が自社サイトを点検するAI診断ツールの開発も進められているという。

items.title: 東京都の子育て支援QUOカードPayで残高減少、利用不能分を再発行へ
items.summary: 東京都の出産・子育て応援事業で、ポイントと交換したQUOカードPayの一部が使えなくなったり残高が減ったりする事象が確認された。都は対象者の未使用分に相当するデジタルコードを再発行する方針で、委託先への不正アクセスの影響も調べている。

items.title: 日本政府、先端AIの安全確保と報告の義務化を検討。命令違反には罰則も
items.summary: 日本政府が高性能AIを提供する事業者への規制を検討している。安全確保措置や国への報告を義務付け、命令違反には罰則を科す案が示された。規制対象の線引きや安全性の評価方法を巡り、AI企業からも提案が出ている。

items.title: Dasharo v1.1.8/v0.9.6、MSI PRO Z690-A/PRO Z790-Pの起動障害を修正、Secure Bootを既定で有効に
items.summary: 3mdebがMSI製マザーボード向けのオープンソースファームウェアDasharoを更新した。起動やストレージ認識の問題を修正し、DDR4のXMPを改善するとともに、Secure Bootなどの保護機能を初期設定で有効にした。

items.title: スイス当局、AIエージェントによるサイバー攻撃を国内で初確認。重要インフラ事業者にも被害
items.summary: スイス当局が国内で初確認したAIエージェント利用のサイバー攻撃では、重要インフラ事業者を含む被害組織のITシステムが侵害された。イタリア当局も大規模な侵害活動を確認。両国は外部公開システムの早期更新を勧告した。

items.title: サツドラの個人情報流出、委託先の開発環境で誤公開。アクセス記録にも欠落
items.summary: サツドラの顧客情報がサイバーエージェントの開発環境から流出した。システム移行時のファイルの誤配置に加え、公開領域の定期点検が不十分だった。公開期間の一部についてはアクセス記録も残っていない。

items.title: 生成AIの採用推薦に不要な個人属性、東京科学大学などが開示リスクを検証
items.summary: 生成AIは個人情報の開示の細かさに関する制限を守りながら、依頼された仕事には不要な情報を出力することがある。東京科学大学と理化学研究所の研究者らが採用推薦や融資などを題材に検証し、情報の必要性を独立して評価する手法を示した。

items.title: Microsoft Storeでマルウェア導入用アプリ配信、Microsoftは当初の通報に規約違反なしと回答
items.summary: Microsoft Storeで配信されたSetup Assistantがマルウェアの導入に使われていた。Microsoftは通報に規約違反なしと回答。11月26日、日本・米国・カナダを指定したWeb版URLで製品ページが表示されなかった。

items.title: 1Password、従業員のGitHubアカウント侵害で一部顧客情報流出。保管庫へのアクセスは確認されず
items.summary: パスワード管理サービスの1Passwordで一部顧客の氏名やメールアドレス、一部の招待・復旧用トークンなどが流出した。暗号化された保管庫そのものへのアクセスは確認されておらず、利用者には不審な連絡への警戒が呼びかけられている。

items.title: Claudeで作ったアプリをWindows・macOSにインストール、全プラン向けにベータ提供
items.summary: AnthropicはClaudeが生成したアプリをWindowsとmacOSにインストールできる機能のベータ提供を開始した。独立したウィンドウで動作し、許可に応じて通知やファイル操作も可能になる。

items.title: 米司法省、国際オンライン詐欺の取り締まり成果を公表。資産凍結と人身取引被害者の救出
items.summary: 米司法省が国際的なオンライン詐欺対策の成果を公表した。海外の詐欺拠点の解体支援に加え、不正資産の凍結や詐欺サイトの停止、拠点で働くことを強制された人々の救出にも各国の当局が協力した。

items.title: Rackspace Spot、セキュリティ侵害を受け12月9日にサービス終了へ
items.summary: 米クラウド事業者RackspaceがRackspace Spotの提供終了を決めた。日本時間12月9日午前8時に稼働中の処理を停止する予定で、利用者はデータの退避と移行に加え、漏えいの恐れがある認証情報への対応を求められている。

items.title: EU、量子技術法案を発表。投資基金の設立と耐量子暗号への移行を提案
items.summary: 欧州委員会が量子技術法案を発表した。加盟国の研究・産業支援を連携させ、量子技術やAIなどに投資する新基金の設立を目指す。量子コンピュータの開発を促すとともに、その進歩に備えた耐量子暗号への移行を公共調達でも進める案を示した。

items.title: Todoistに不正アクセス、採用終了後も残った旧方式のパスワードハッシュが流出
items.summary: タスク管理サービスのTodoistで顧客情報が流出した。旧式のSHA-1によるパスワードハッシュに加え、外部サービスとの連携も影響を受けた。Todoistは旧方式への対応を廃止し、対象者に認証情報の再設定などを案内している。

items.title: アイオーデータ、法人向けNAS「HDL-LH」を発表。物理ボタンで管理画面を保護
items.summary: アイオーデータが法人向けNASの最上位モデルHDL-LHシリーズを発表した。本体のボタン操作を管理画面へのログイン条件にでき、ファイル共有向けにはLAN DISK初のSMBアカウントロックを搭載する。

items.title: タイムズカー情報漏洩、見舞金3000円の受け取り方法を発表。12月1日から順次案内
items.summary: タイムズカーの見舞金は、暗号化された本人確認書類の画像へのアクセスと外部送信の痕跡が確認された利用者が対象。対象の現会員は現金3000円か同額のカーシェアeチケットを選べる。対象の退会者と入会未完了者には現金を支払う。

items.title: 楽天証券、個人情報約441万件の漏洩を発表。口座未開設者の情報も約119万件
items.summary: 楽天証券が追加調査で確認した個人情報の漏洩は約441万件。実際の預かり資産残高も対象に含まれ、口座開設の申し込みをして開設に至らなかった人の情報も約119万件に及ぶ。

items.title: Firefox 161公開。通常ウィンドウに閲覧データ消去ボタンを順次導入、VPNはサイト別制御に
items.summary: MozillaはFirefox 161でデスクトップ版の通常の閲覧ウィンドウにもデータ消去ボタンを順次導入する。デスクトップ版の内蔵VPNは全体の設定にかかわらずサイトごとに使用の有無を指定できるようになった。

items.summary: Improved the query speed of all views which contain submits and their current status.

items.title: PAN-OS Fragnesia exploited; 1Password breach; GeoServer attacks
items.summary: Palo Alto Networks confirms Fragnesia exploitation on PAN-OS devices with exposed management interfaces. 1Password disclosed a GitHub-based breach, and GeoServer flaws are being probed.

items.title: NCSC-2026-0524 [1.00] [H/H] Kwetsbaarheid verholpen in Drupal core
items.summary: Drupal heeft een nieuwe kwetsbaarheid verholpen in Drupal core, specifiek in het install.php bestand en in versies tot 10.6.23 en van 11.0.0 tot 11.4.14. Het install.php bestand bevatte kwetsbaarheden die konden leiden tot overname van de site indien het bestand toegankelijk bleef na de SA-CORE-2026-017 advisory, warvoor het NCSC de eerdere advisory NCSC-2026-0507 heeft gepubliceerd. Daarnaast is er een Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions kwetsbaarheid aanwezig in de genoemde versies, die Forceful Browsing aanvallen mogelijk maakt. Deze kwetsbaarheden betreffen authenticatieom…

items.title: NCSC-2026-0515 [1.00] [M/H] Kwetsbaarheid verholpen in OTRS
items.summary: OTRS heeft een kwetsbaarheid verholpen in de Survey endpoint van versies 2024.3.1 tot en met 2026.8.1. De kwetsbaarheid betreft een SQL-injectie in de Survey endpoint, waardoor ongeauthenticeerde externe aanvallers willekeurige SQL-queries kunnen injecteren. Dit gebeurt zonder dat authenticatie of een geldige survey key vereist is. Door misbruik van deze kwetsbaarheid kan een aanvaller ticketinformatie opvragen en gevoelige data uit de backend database extraheren. Dit beïnvloedt de integriteit en vertrouwelijkheid van de gegevens in het ticketingsysteem.

items.title: USN-9016-2: Apache HTTP Server regression
items.summary: USN-9016-1 fixed vulnerabilities in Apache2. Unfortunately the upstream fix introduced a regression that prevented cookies being set during a redirect under certain circumstances. This update fixes the problem. Original advisory details: Zhang San, Ankit Prateek, Zhen Kong, SeungHyun Cho, Ryoma Nishioka, Keita Sode and Hyojae Lee discovered that Apache HTTP Server did not correctly handle certain memory operations. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 14.04 LTS, Ubuntu 16.04 LTS, Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04…

items.title: USN-9190-2: Linux kernel (HWE) vulnerabilities
items.summary: Several security issues were discovered in the Linux kernel. An attacker could possibly use these to compromise the system. This update corrects flaws in the following subsystems: - S390 architecture; - x86 architecture; - Block layer subsystem; - Cryptographic API; - Compute Acceleration Framework; - FireWire subsystem; - GPIO subsystem; - GPU drivers; - Microsoft Hyper-V drivers; - I2C subsystem; - Multiple devices driver; - Network drivers; - STMicroelectronics network drivers; - Power supply drivers; - S/390 drivers; - SCSI subsystem; - SPI subsystem; - TCM subsystem; - UFS subsystem; - Fi…

items.title: USN-9209-1: Simple DirectMedia Layer vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that Simple DirectMedia Layer incorrectly handled memory when encountering errors during OpenGL ES streaming texture creation. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause applications using Simple DirectMedia Layer to consume resources, resulting in a denial of service.

items.summary: Learn how to schedule an email in Outlook for Windows, Mac, mobile, and the web. And learn an easy way to protect your email privacy.

items.title: USN-9211-1: Plexus Utils vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that Plexus Utils did not properly sanitize file paths when extracting archives. If a user or automated system were tricked into extracting a specially crafted archive, an attacker could possibly use this issue to write arbitrary files and execute arbitrary code.

items.title: 1Password Breach Traced to Hijacked Employee GitHub Account
items.summary: The 1Password breach disclosed on November 25, 2026, started with a single compromised employee GitHub account. An attacker used it to reach private source code, push malicious code into backend services and download account records for a subset of 1Password customers, including names and email addresses. 1Password says vault contents, the items in them and […]

items.title: USN-9208-1: alsa-lib vulnerabilities
items.summary: It was discovered that the ALSA library incorrectly handled certain crafted topology files and control element identifiers. An attacker could possibly use these issues to cause a denial of service or expose sensitive information. These issues were only addressed in Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, Ubuntu 24.04 LTS and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS.

items.title: USN-9207-1: Apache Commons BCEL vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that Apache Commons BCEL incorrectly cached classes under their self-declared names without validating them against the requested name. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause BCEL to return or verify a different class than the one requested.

items.title: USN-9204-1: dav1d vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that dav1d incorrectly handled certain AV1 video streams with extremely large frame sizes. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause dav1d to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.

items.title: USN-9198-1: HTTP::Tiny vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that HTTP::Tiny incorrectly forwarded credential headers supplied by the caller, such as Authorization, Cookie and Proxy-Authorization, when following cross-origin redirects, including redirects from HTTPS to HTTP. An attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive information.

items.title: USN-9201-1: NetworkManager vulnerability
items.summary: Juthawong Naisanguansee discovered that NetworkManager on Ubuntu incorrectly granted the whoopsie user unrestricted D-Bus access to root-only methods. A local attacker who can execute code as the whoopsie user could possibly use this issue to disrupt system networking or alter NetworkManager logging and connection configurations.

items.title: USN-9197-1: Speex vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that Speex incorrectly handled oversize input when appending data to a bit buffer not owned by the library. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Speex to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code.

items.title: OmegaLinux 4.0
items.summary: OmegaLinux is an Arch-based, rolling-release Linux distribution featuring the lightweight LXDE desktop. It is suitable for installation on older computers with as little as 1 GB of memory. OmegaLinux was originally based on Lubuntu, but it was rebuilt on top of an Arch Linux base in February 2026.

items.title: NagisinnraLinux 1.1.2
items.summary: NagisinnraLinux is a Japanese Linux distribution based on Debian's "Stable" branch. Featuring a lightweight Xfce desktop, it is specifically designed to revive older hardware and provide a snappy and minimal, yet fully functional desktop environment for daily use. The distribution's main features include out-of-the-box support for the Japanese language, advanced memory optimisation, use of zram compression to guarantee smooth multitasking, and removal of unnecessary and redundant services to maximise battery life and CPU responsiveness.

items.title: Mint 27-beta
items.summary: Linux Mint is an Ubuntu-based distribution whose goal is to provide a classic desktop experience with many convenient, custom tools and optional out-of-the-box multimedia support. It also adds a custom desktop and menus, several unique configuration tools, and a web-based package installation interface. Linux Mint is compatible with Ubuntu software repositories. Besides its Ubuntu-based flavour, the project also produces a separate "Debian" edition (called LMDE), based on the latest stable Debian version.

items.title: I'll Have a Raw JSON, Please: Leaking a LangChain Assistant Through Format Coercion
items.summary: A guardrail written in the system prompt reads the question, not the answer. During a red team exercise, a customer's support assistant refused every direct question about itself and never gave up its system prompt. Yet asking for raw JSON instead of prose turned its internal state into a reply: tool calls and their arguments, retrieved documents with their metadata, and the output of its safety classifier. items.title: AI Agent Collisions as Dreams of 1990s Cybersecurity Leads To Solving Wrong Problem - James Robinson - BSW #475
items.summary: As organizations accelerate AI adoption, a new security challenge is emerging: AI Agent Collisions. Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents are increasingly operating across business applications, accessing sensitive data, invoking APIs, and taking actions on behalf of users and organizations. Without visibility into which agents exist, what they can access, and how they interact, organizations risk creating unintended access paths, conflicting actions, data exposure, and gaps in security oversight. James Robinson, CISO at Netskope, joins Business Security Weekly to explore the emerging problem…
